metadata.style: Sketchy-medical-style scene-based mnemonics. Per-symbol logical link via phonetic, shape, acronym, or concept. Pharmacological subfamilies share visual base; functional opposites use contrasting visuals.
design_rules: PRIMARY HOOK first: the symbol must immediately evoke the RECEPTOR/DRUG name or number.
FUNCTION encoded second: how the symbol behaves matches the pharmacology.
Same concept = same recurring scene/object across all images.
DRUGS use GENERIC NAMES only — never brand names. Each drug has its own constant symbol that travels between scenes.
IONS get their own consistent symbol that appears in every channel they participate in.
Subfamilies sharing pharmacology share visual base; opposing-function subfamilies contrast visually.
user_feedback_log: 2026-05-10: animal-only theme rejected — needs per-symbol logic.
2026-05-11: subfamilies must encode functional difference (Gs vs Gi).
2026-05-11: PRIMARY HOOK to receptor itself comes before function. Memorable cultural references (Professor X for 5-HT6) work great.
2026-05-11: drugs need their own constant symbols across scenes (Flumazenil = FLU character).
2026-05-11: GENERIC names only — no brand names ever. Lithium ≠ bipolar scene (Lithium itself = Li-ion battery).

DOPA_MINE.scene_name: DOPA-MINE Co. — coal mine extracting dopamine ore
DOPA_MINE.setting: A working coal mine. Sign at entrance: 'DOPA-MINE Co.'. Inside: 4 sections labeled by pathway — Mesolimbic (heart-shaped chamber), Mesocortical (think-bubble chamber), Nigrostriatal (motor gear chamber), Tuberoinfundibular (milk-pump chamber).
recurring_elements: Vertical elevators going UP = D1-family receptors (Gs/excitatory)
Red barriers/locks blocking flow = D2-family receptors (Gi/inhibitory)
Coal carts = vesicular dopamine release
Newspaper PYRAMID hats labeled 'EXTRA' near nigrostriatal section = EPS
Milk pump at tuberoinfundibular section = prolactin
DOPA_MINE.hebrew_explanation: מכרה DOPA-MINE — סצנה ראשית לדופמין. ארבעה אגפים (מסולימבי, מסוקורטיקלי, ניגרוסטריאטלי, טוברואינפונדיבולרי). מעליות עולות = D1-family (Gs); מחסומים אדומים = D2-family (Gi); קרונות = שחרור דופמין.

BUS_LINE_1A.setting: Old wooden bus-stop booth. Big sign: '1A'. A frantic rabbit sits trembling on the bench (= anxiety patient awaiting anxiolysis).
recurring_elements: Different buses arriving = different 1A partial agonists (Buspirone bus, Vilazodone bus, etc.)
Late bus = autoreceptor delay-of-onset for SSRIs (4-6 weeks)
BUS_LINE_1A.hebrew_explanation: תחנת אוטובוס 1A. שפן רועד = חרדה. אוטובוסים שונים בקו = אגוניסטים חלקיים שונים ל-5-HT1A. אוטובוס מאחר = השהיית הופעת SSRI.

TAROT_2A.setting: Dim Victorian parlor. Round table with TWO Ace tarot cards. Tie-dye hippie reader. Walls swirl with psychedelic colors. Adjacent rooms: KITCHEN (5-HT2C), WATER-GATE ROOM (5-HT3), LIBRARY (5-HT6).
recurring_elements: Hippie reader (tie-dye shirt) = LSD/Psilocybin agonist
Officer with flashlight = atypical antipsychotic (turns off the trip)
Officer with mirror = Pimavanserin (inverse agonist, flips cards face-down)
TAROT_2A.hebrew_explanation: פרלור טארוט אפלולי עם שני קלפי Ace = 5-HT2A. ההיפי הקורא = פסיכדלים. שוטר עם פנס = אנטיפסיכוטי אטיפי. חדרים סמוכים: מטבח (2C), חדר-מים (5-HT3), ספרייה (5-HT6).

CONVENIENCE_STORE_7.setting: Glowing neon-sign 7-Eleven at midnight. Clock shows 7 AM/PM. Night-clerk on duty.
recurring_elements: Night-clerk turning off neon = Lurasidone blocking 5-HT7
CONVENIENCE_STORE_7.hebrew_explanation: 7-Eleven פתוח 24/7. השלט 7 = קולטן 5-HT7. ה-clerk הלילי = Lurasidone שמכבה אורות = שיקום מקצב יממה.

ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.scene_name: Alpha wolf pack in a snowy forest
ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.setting: Snowy pine forest. A wolf pack on the hunt. Some lone alphas charge forward, others stay behind on radio. Each wolf wears a numbered tag.
recurring_elements: Lone alpha wolf (#1) = α1 receptor — true alpha hunts, post-synaptic action
Two wolves (one '#2' tag) = α2 receptor — #2 wolf pretends but is actually autoreceptor, calling pack back
Tranquilizer dart from a hunter = α1 blockade (Prazosin, antipsychotic α1 side effect)
ALPHA_WOLF_PACK.hebrew_explanation: להקת זאבי אלפא ביער מושלג. זאב בודד = α1 (אמיתי, פוסט-סינפסי). שני זאבים שבהם #2 = α2 (אוטו-רצפטור, רק מתחזה לאלפא).

BEETHOVEN_ORCHESTRA.setting: Concert hall. Beethoven (white wig, intense face) conducts. Different batons numbered for each symphony. Orchestra has heart-drums section (β1) and wind/brass section (β2).
recurring_elements: Beethoven with '#1' baton + heart-drums section = β1 (heart)
Beethoven with '#2' baton + winds/brass = β2 (lungs)
A fishing NET hangs by the stage door = NET transporter; Beethoven catches stray notes (NE) and returns them
BEETHOVEN_ORCHESTRA.hebrew_explanation: תזמורת בטהובן. שרביט #1 + תופי-לב = β1 (לב). שרביט #2 + נשיפה = β2 (ריאות). רשת דייגים בכניסה = NET, בטהובן 'דג' תווים תועים (NE) חזרה.

AA_HOTEL.setting: Old hotel called 'Aa Hotel'. 5 floors. Each floor offers a different experience based on the α-subunit composition.
recurring_elements: Floor 1 (α1): Sleep Lobby — giant bed in the entrance
Floor 2 (α2): Calm Lounge — armchairs and tea
Floor 3 (α3): Group-therapy Room — circle of chairs
Floor 5 (α5): Memory Penthouse — secure vault
Hotel Manager = GABA itself (holds master key)
Green CHLORINE SOLDIERS rushing INTO neurons = Cl⁻ influx → hyperpolarization → inhibition
Barbed-wire fence around hotel = Phenobarbital
Bayit-B small synagogue next door = GABA-B (metabotropic, Baclofen prays there)
AA_HOTEL.hebrew_explanation: מלון Aa בן 5 קומות — קולטן GABA-A. שם המלון = α-α (תת-יחידות). חיילי כלוריד ירוקים = Cl⁻ נכנסים פנימה. גדר תיל = ברביטורט. בית כנסת בית-ב' לידו = GABA-B.

ASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR.setting: Heavy iron door labeled 'NMDA'. Outside: chalk-white Ca²⁺ guests with '2+' badges wait in line. The lock has a horseshoe MAGNET (Mg²⁺) wedged in it. Above the door: a neon sign that flickers when depolarized.
recurring_elements: Mr. Asparagus (Mexican, methyl-mustache CH₃) = NMDA agonist itself (N-methyl-D-Aspartate)
G-shaped gray pebble at his feet = Glycine co-agonist
Horseshoe magnet in lock = Mg²⁺ block
Chalk-white guests with '2+' badges in line = Ca²⁺ entering
Neon sign flickering = depolarization (releases the magnet plug)
ASPARAGUS_VIP_DOOR.hebrew_explanation: דלת מועדון NMDA. מר אספרגוס (N-methyl-D-Aspartate) = אגוניסט. חלוק-G אפור = Glycine קו-אגוניסט. מגנט פרסה = Mg²⁺ block. אורחים מסויידים '2+' = Ca²⁺ נכנסים.

DAIRY_FARM.scene_name: Dairy Farm — opioid receptors and their animal residents
DAIRY_FARM.setting: A green farm on a hill. Each animal produces a different opioid-receptor effect. Hay bales, milk pails, and a Delta-Airlines plane droning overhead.
recurring_elements: Mooing cow ('MOO') = μ-opioid receptor
Grumpy goat with 'K' tag, kicking = κ-opioid receptor (dysphoria)
Delta-Airlines plane (triangular logo) overhead = δ-opioid receptor (less clinical)
Peaceful endogenous farmer = endorphins
Pails labeled: Analgesia / Euphoria / Constipation / Resp. Depression / Miosis = the spectrum of μ-effects
DAIRY_FARM.hebrew_explanation: חוות חלב לאופיואידים. פרה 'MOO' = μ. תיש בועט 'K' = κ (דיספוריה). מטוס Delta = δ. דליי מסומנים: אנלגזיה / אופוריה / דיכוי נשימה / עצירות.

WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.scene_name: Alice in Wonderland — Mad Hatter's tea party (Muscarinic receptors)
WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.setting: Iconic Wonderland tea party. Each character maps to one muscarinic receptor by NUMBER + FUNCTION. The whole tableau goes haywire under anticholinergic blockade.
recurring_elements: White Rabbit with '1 O'Clock' pocket watch = M1 (CNS, memory of time)
Queen of Hearts holding TWO '2-of-Hearts' cards = M2 (heart)
Mad Hatter with 3 dripping teacups (saliva/tears/sweat) = M3 (glands)
Tweedledee & Tweedledum at the corners = M4 / M5 (less clinical)
Anticholinergic toxicity = whole scene gone wild: Mad Hatter mad, Red Queen flushed, March Hare hot, teacups bone-dry, Cheshire Cat invisible (pupils dilated)
WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY.hebrew_explanation: מסיבת התה של Alice במולנדרלנד — כל דמות = קולטן מוסקריני. הארנב הלבן (שעון 1 O'Clock) = M1. מלכת לבבות (2 of Hearts) = M2. ה-Mad Hatter עם 3 כוסות = M3. רעלת אנטיכולינרגית = הכל יוצא משליטה.

CIGARETTE_THEATER.scene_name: Cigarette Theater — Nicotinic receptors on a smoky stage
CIGARETTE_THEATER.setting: Dim theater with cigarettes as branded characters on stage. Smoke curls. A wooden match (Acetylcholine = אצית) ignites scenes.
recurring_elements: Cigarette brand '42' = nAChR α4β2 (Hitchhiker's Guide answer — 4+2)
Old wise grandpa with 'Lucky 7' cigarette = nAChR α7 (cognition + schizophrenia hypothesis)
Backstage stagehand cigarettes = NMJ-type (α1β1γδ)
Wooden match (אצית) struck = Acetylcholine the agonist
Half-smoked cigarette in a smoker's hand = Varenicline partial agonism
CIGARETTE_THEATER.hebrew_explanation: תיאטרון סיגריות לקולטנים ניקוטיניים. מותג '42' = α4β2. 'Lucky 7' של סבא חכם = α7. גפרור עץ (אצית) = Acetylcholine.

H_HOUSE.scene_name: Histamine House — H-shaped building, 4 floors for H1-H4
H_HOUSE.setting: A literal H-shaped house. Each floor is a different histamine receptor subtype.
recurring_elements: Floor 1 (Living Room) — snoozing couch resident = H1 (sedation/allergy/weight)
Floor 2 (Kitchen) — leaking 'H2O' pots of stomach acid = H2 (gastric)
Floor 3 (Study) — autoreceptor professor dozing on his own desk = H3 (CNS auto, cognition)
Floor 4 (Rooftop) — immune-cell pigeons circling = H4 (immune)
H_HOUSE.hebrew_explanation: בית בצורת H בן 4 קומות = קולטני היסטמין. קומה 1 (סלון נמנום) = H1. קומה 2 (מטבח H2O) = H2 (חומצת קיבה). קומה 3 (חדר עבודה) = H3 (אוטו-רצפטור). קומה 4 (גג) = H4 (חיסון).

ER_GUARD_POST.setting: Doorway labeled 'ER'. A sentry guard with 'S-1' badge stands at attention, escorting misfolded proteins.
recurring_elements: Guard with 'S-1' badge = sigma-1 chaperone protein
Misfolded proteins arriving in stress = clients of the chaperone
Fluvoxamine + Dextromethorphan visits = drug agonists at σ1
ER_GUARD_POST.hebrew_explanation: סנטרי-S1 בכניסה ל-ER (אנדופלסמטית רטיקולום) = chaperone protein sigma-1. Fluvoxamine ו-Dextromethorphan = מבקרים תכופים.

RAPHE_TAPESTRY.scene_name: Raphe nuclei — serotonin's tapestry workshop in the brainstem
RAPHE_TAPESTRY.setting: A narrow Persian-rug weaving workshop running down the brainstem midline. Weavers spin serotonin-yarn into rugs that get shipped EVERYWHERE.
recurring_elements: Tapestry seam down the middle = raphe (literally 'seam' in Greek)
Weavers = raphe neurons producing 5-HT
Shipping crates labeled cortex/limbic/hypothalamus = projections everywhere
Old loom that won't start for 4-6 weeks = SSRI delay-of-onset (autoreceptor downregulation)
RAPHE_TAPESTRY.hebrew_explanation: סדנת שטיחים פרסיים לאורך הגזע מוחי = גרעיני raphe. אורגים = נוירוני 5-HT. השם 'raphe' = 'תפר' ביוונית.

LOCUS_COERULEUS_BLUEPOST.scene_name: Locus Coeruleus — the BLUE police box of norepinephrine
LOCUS_COERULEUS_BLUEPOST.setting: A literal BLUE police box (locus = spot, coeruleus = blue) at the back of the brainstem. Every emergency call goes through it.
recurring_elements: Blue box dispatcher = LC neurons firing in arousal
Phone lines fanning out = NE projections everywhere
Panic-button red light = hyperactive LC in panic/PTSD/withdrawal
Prazosin curtain = α1 blockade calming the dispatch noise (PTSD nightmares)
LOCUS_COERULEUS_BLUEPOST.hebrew_explanation: תא טלפון משטרתי כחול = locus coeruleus ('כתם כחול' בלטינית). מוקד כל ה-NE במוח. מתפרסם לכל מקום.

TUBEROMAMMILLARY_DAIRY.setting: A dairy section in the hypothalamus (mammillary = mammary). Cows pump out histamine to keep the brain awake.
recurring_elements: Mammary cows pumping histamine = TMN neurons → wakefulness
Histamine bottles distributed to H-House = upstream of all H1/H3 effects
Dimmer switch when blocked = sedation from H1 antagonists
TUBEROMAMMILLARY_DAIRY.hebrew_explanation: פרות מימרי בהיפותלמוס הפוסטריורי = גרעין histamine. שואבות היסטמין שמדליק את המוח (ערות).

MEYNERT_MYNAH.scene_name: Basal nucleus of Meynert — the talking Mynah bird
MEYNERT_MYNAH.setting: A wise old MYNAH bird perched in the basal forebrain. It mimics what it hears (cortical ACh = memory).
recurring_elements: Mynah bird = basal nucleus of Meynert (phonetic)
Bird whispers memorize cortex = cholinergic projections for memory
Bird dies = Alzheimer's pathology (skipped per user, but explains baseline)
MEYNERT_MYNAH.hebrew_explanation: ציפור מינה חכמה בבזאל פורברין = הגרעין הבזאלי של מיינרט (אצטיל-כולין → קליפת המוח, זיכרון).

Mg2+.mnemonic_link: Mg = Magnet (both start with M). Magnetic block of NMDA = literal magnet on the door.
Mg2+.hebrew_explanation: מגנט פרסה. Mg = Magnesium = מגנט (אותה אות M). חוסם NMDA במנוחה.

Ca2+.symbol: Chalk-white VIP guest with '2+' lapel pin
Ca2+.mnemonic_link: Ca = Calcium = chalk (calcareous). 2+ = the divalent charge as a name-badge.
Ca2+.hebrew_explanation: אורחים מסויידים-לבנים עם תגית '2+'. Ca = סידן = chalk (גיר). 2+ = המטען החיובי.

Cl-.mnemonic_link: Cl = Chlorine (green gas in WWI). Minus shield = the negative charge.
Cl-.hebrew_explanation: חיילים ירוקים עם מגן '−'. Cl = chlorine = הגז הירוק במלחמת העולם הראשונה. נכנס לתעלת GABA-A → היפרפולריזציה.

Na+.symbol: Soldier wearing white SALT crystals with '+' epaulets
Na+.mnemonic_link: Na = Sodium = salt. + epaulets = positive charge.
Na+.hebrew_explanation: חיילים עם גבישי מלח לבנים ו-'+'. Na = sodium = מלח. עיקרי בתעלות AMPA, nAChR.

K+.mnemonic_link: K = Potassium = banana (high-potassium food). + = positive charge.
K+.hebrew_explanation: בננות צהובות עם '+' . K = potassium = banana (עשירה בקליום). זרימה החוצה → ריפולריזציה.

D1_receptor.symbol: Single elevator with '1↑' button going UP to PFC top floor
D1_receptor.mnemonic_link: UP arrow = Gs/excitatory. '1' = D1. Top floor = PFC (working memory).
D1_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism = elevator rises bright; antagonism = stuck at ground.
D1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן D1 — דופמין מ-D1-family (Gs, מעורר). סמל: מעלית '1↑' עולה לקומה העליונה של PFC. תפקיד: זיכרון עבודה, סימפטומים חיוביים. Gs = ↑cAMP.

D5_receptor.symbol: Glass elevator '5' ascending through 5 hippocampal library floors
D5_receptor.mnemonic_link: Same UP/Gs visual as D1. '5' = D5. Library = hippocampus/memory.
D5_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן D5 — D1-family (Gs). סמל: מעלית '5' בספריית ההיפוקמפוס. בעיקר זיכרון. פחות קליני.

D2_receptor.symbol: Massive RED BARRIER labeled '2' across mesolimbic track with a foreman at lever
D2_receptor.mnemonic_link: DOWN = Gi/inhibitory. '2' = D2. Mesolimbic = psychosis track.
D2_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism = foreman LOWERS barrier (carts pile up; EPS pyramid-hatted workers spawn; prolactin pump leaks). Partial agonism = barrier hovers halfway (Aripiprazole/Brexpiprazole/Cariprazine). Agonism = barrier raised wide → runaway carts = stimulant psychosis.
D2_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן D2 — D2-family (Gi, מעכב). הקולטן ה-קריטי ביותר באנטיפסיכוטיים. סמל: מחסום אדום ענק '2' במסלול מסולימבי. חסימה = פסיכוזה מטופלת; אבל גם פירמידות EPS, חלב פרולקטין, ועוד.

D3_receptor.symbol: Three small red barriers in a heart-shaped (limbic) sub-chamber
D3_receptor.mnemonic_link: Red-barrier base = Gi. '3' barriers. Heart shape = limbic.
D3_receptor.function_depiction: Cariprazine operates ONLY these three (selective partial agonist).
D3_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן D3 — D2-family. סמל: שלושה מחסומים בלימבי (לב). Cariprazine סלקטיבי-D3 (דיכאון בביפולר).

D4_receptor.category: Dopamine D2-family (Gi) — high clozapine affinity, low EPS
D4_receptor.symbol: Four-bolt locking mechanism on a SILENT chamber door
D4_receptor.mnemonic_link: Same red-locked base (Gi). 4 bolts = D4. Silence = low EPS.
D4_receptor.function_depiction: Clozapine carries a Z-shaped master key that fits all 4 bolts.
D4_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן D4 — D2-family. סמל: ארבעה ברגים על דלת שקטה (low-EPS). Clozapine עם מפתח-Z פותח שם.

5-HT1A_receptor.symbol: Bus-stop '1A' with anxious rabbit on bench
5-HT1A_receptor.mnemonic_link: Bus line 1A. Rabbit = anxiety. Bus arriving = anxiolysis.
5-HT1A_receptor.function_depiction: Partial agonists (Buspirone, Vilazodone, Vortioxetine, Aripiprazole) = different buses on the SAME 1A line. Empty bus for 4-6 weeks = SSRI delay-of-onset (autoreceptor desensitization).
5-HT1A_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT1A — סרוטונין (Gi, אוטו-רצפטור + post-syn). שפן רגוע באוטובוס 1A. Buspirone, Vilazodone, Vortioxetine, Aripiprazole = אוטובוסים שונים בקו 1A (partial agonists). דחיית-הופעת SSRI דרך desensitization.

5-HT2A_receptor.category: Serotonin (Gq, cortical) — psychedelic + atypical antipsychotic target
5-HT2A_receptor.symbol: Tarot table with 2 Ace cards, tie-dye hippie reader, swirling psychedelic walls
5-HT2A_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (LSD/Psilocybin/DMT) = walls swirl wildly. Antagonism (all atypicals, Mirtazapine, Trazodone) = officer with flashlight turns lights off. Inverse agonism (Pimavanserin) = officer flips cards face-down.
5-HT2A_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT2A — סרוטונין (Gq, cortical). שולחן טארוט עם 2 קלפי Ace. אגוניסט = LSD/פסילוסיבין. אנטיפסיכוטיים אטיפיים חוסמים = מנגנון מרכזי שלהם. Pimavanserin = inverse agonist.

5-HT2C_receptor.symbol: Kitchen with TWO chefs guarding cookie jar
5-HT2C_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Mirtazapine, Olanzapine, Quetiapine) = chefs KO'd, cookies stolen → weight gain.
5-HT2C_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT2C — סרוטונין (Gq, היפותלמוס/תיאבון). מטבח עם 2 שפים שומרים על צנצנת עוגיות. חסימה (Mirtazapine, Olanzapine, Quetiapine) = שודדים שמתפרצים = עליה במשקל.

5-HT3_receptor.category: Serotonin — LIGAND-GATED ION CHANNEL (unique!). CTZ + gut.
5-HT3_receptor.symbol: Three iron CHANNELS gushing green vomit-water
5-HT3_receptor.mnemonic_link: 3 = three gates. Iron channels emphasize ionotropic uniqueness.
5-HT3_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Ondansetron, Mirtazapine, Vortioxetine) = three identical PLUGS seal the gates.
5-HT3_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT3 — ה-יחיד היונוטרופי בסרוטונין! שלושה שערי ברזל לוהטים זורקים מי-בחילה ירוקים. חסימה (Ondansetron, Mirtazapine, Vortioxetine) = פקקים שעוצרים בחילה.

5-HT6_receptor.symbol: Library with 6 framed PhD diplomas; old professor reads
5-HT6_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT6 — סרוטונין (Gs, קוגניציה). ספרייה עם 6 תעודות PhD. חסימה (Vortioxetine) = פרוקוגניטיבי.

5-HT7_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Lurasidone) = clerk turns off neon, locks doors (restored sleep).
5-HT7_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן 5-HT7 — סרוטונין (Gs, מקצב יממה). 7-Eleven פתוח 24/7. חסימה (Lurasidone) = מקצב שינה-ערות משוקם.

SERT.symbol: Postal carrier in 'SERT' uniform collecting serotonin packages
SERT.function_depiction: SSRI = a 'NO PICKUPS TODAY' sign blocks the carrier. Packages pile up in synapse (more serotonin available). 4-6 week delay.
SERT.hebrew_explanation: מובל סרוטונין — מטרת SSRI/SNRI/TCA. דוור 'SERT' אוסף חבילות מהסינפסה. SSRI = שלט 'אין משלוחים' = יותר סרוטונין בסינפסה. דחיית הופעת 4-6 שבועות.

alpha1_receptor.symbol: Single LONE ALPHA WOLF charging at full hunt
alpha1_receptor.mnemonic_link: α1 = ONE wolf = true alpha. Hunt = post-synaptic action (vasoconstriction, alertness).
alpha1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Prazosin, antipsychotic α1 block) = tranquilizer dart → wolf sits down → orthostasis. Prazosin specifically tames the wolf's nightmares (PTSD use).
alpha1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן α1 — אדרנרגי פוסט-סינפסי (Gq, מעורר). זאב אלפא אחד יוצא לציד. חסימה (Prazosin = הרגעת סיוטי PTSD; אנטיפסיכוטיים = orthostasis צד).

alpha2_receptor.symbol: Two wolves; the one tagged '#2' pretends to be alpha but radios pack 'come back to base'
alpha2_receptor.mnemonic_link: α2 = TWO wolves. The #2 wolf isn't truly alpha → autoreceptor function (negative feedback).
alpha2_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Clonidine, Guanfacine) = friendly handlers feed the #2 wolf → whole pack calms (lowers central NE). ADHD = overactive pack settles.
alpha2_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן α2 — אוטו-רצפטור פרה-סינפסי (Gi). שני זאבים שבהם '#2' מתחזה לאלפא וקורא לעדר חזור. Clonidine, Guanfacine = אגוניסטים שמרגיעים את העדר = ADHD, גמילת אופיואידים, יל"ד.

beta1_receptor.symbol: Beethoven holding baton '#1' conducting heart-shaped drum section
beta1_receptor.mnemonic_link: BETHoven = β. Symphony #1 = β1. Drums = heart pounding.
beta1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Propranolol, Metoprolol-class) = 'Quiet' sign mutes the drum section.
beta1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן β1 — אדרנרגי Gs (לב). בטהובן עם שרביט '#1' מנצח על תופי לב. חסימה (Propranolol) = לב רגוע.

beta2_receptor.symbol: Beethoven holding baton '#2' conducting brass/wind section
beta2_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Albuterol) = winds blast open. Non-selective β-block (e.g. Propranolol) silences the winds → bronchospasm risk.
beta2_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן β2 — אדרנרגי Gs (ריאות, שריר). בטהובן עם שרביט '#2' מנצח על כלי נשיפה. אגוניסט (Albuterol) = פתיחת דרכי אוויר; חסימה לא-סלקטיבית = ברונכוספסם.

NET.symbol: Fishing NET hanging by the stage door — Beethoven catches stray notes (NE) with it
NET.mnemonic_link: NET acronym = literal net. Catching notes = re-uptake.
NET.function_depiction: Atomoxetine = small atomic ox tearing holes in the net. Bupropion = bumper-cars also tears net (NDRI). TCAs/SNRIs (Venlafaxine, Duloxetine) = various NET-blockers.
NET.hebrew_explanation: מובל נוראפינפרין — רשת דייגים (NET = רשת!) בכניסת התזמורת. אטומוקסטין, בופרופיון, SNRI, TCA = קורעים בה חורים = יותר NE בסינפסה.

GABA_neurotransmitter.symbol: Aa Hotel manager holding the master key
GABA_neurotransmitter.mnemonic_link: GABA = manager who opens the Cl⁻ doors.
GABA_neurotransmitter.function_depiction: Opens the receptor channel → green chlorine soldiers (Cl⁻) rush in → hyperpolarization (inhibition).
GABA_neurotransmitter.hebrew_explanation: GABA — המעכב הראשי. מנהל מלון Aa עם המפתח הראשי. פותח את התעלה → חיילי כלוריד ירוקים נכנסים → היפרפולריזציה.

GABA_A_receptor.category: GABA-A — ionotropic Cl⁻ channel. Pentameric: usually 2α + 2β + 1γ.
GABA_A_receptor.symbol: The hotel itself — 5-floor building with α-floor-specific functions
GABA_A_receptor.function_depiction: BZD = a partygoer that tickles the manager → doors open MORE FREQUENTLY (↑frequency). Barbiturate (Phenobarbital, barbed-wire fence) = lock-picker holding doors open LONGER (↑duration; high dose can open without GABA → lethal). Alcohol = also bribes the manager. Flumazenil (FLU character with tissues) = security guard who throws BZDs out.
GABA_A_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן GABA-A — תעלת כלוריד יונוטרופית, 5-מרית. המלון עצמו (5 קומות). BZD = מבקר שדגדג את המנהל → הדלת נפתחת תכופות. ברביטורט = פורץ-מנעולים → הדלת נשארת פתוחה זמן רב יותר.

GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.symbol: Floor 1 — Sleep Lobby with giant bed
GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.mnemonic_link: Floor 1 = ground floor = where you crash on arrival.
GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.function_depiction: Z-drugs (Zolpidem, Eszopiclone) = express elevators that ONLY go to Floor 1.
GABA_A_alpha1_subunit.hebrew_explanation: תת-יחידה α1 של GABA-A — קומה 1 'sleep lobby'. Z-drugs (Zolpidem, Eszopiclone) = מעלית אקספרס שיורדת רק לכאן = שינה.

GABA_A_alpha2_alpha3_subunits.mnemonic_link: Middle floors = where you spend the calm part of your stay = anxiolysis.
GABA_A_alpha2_alpha3_subunits.function_depiction: BZDs broadly target these floors (Diazepam, Alprazolam, Lorazepam — anxiolytic action).
GABA_A_alpha2_alpha3_subunits.hebrew_explanation: תת-יחידות α2/α3 — קומות אמצעיות (calm lounge + group therapy). BZD רגילים מטפלים בחרדה דרכן.

GABA_A_alpha5_subunit.symbol: Floor 5 — Memory Penthouse with a vault
GABA_A_alpha5_subunit.function_depiction: Knockout of α5 (e.g. Midazolam pre-surgical) = vault is robbed → amnesia.
GABA_A_alpha5_subunit.hebrew_explanation: תת-יחידה α5 — קומה 5 'memory penthouse' עם כספת. נטרול (Midazolam פרה-ניתוחי) = שדידת הכספת = אמנזיה.

GABA_B_receptor.category: GABA-B — metabotropic (Gi → K⁺ channel opens). NOT a chloride channel!
GABA_B_receptor.symbol: Small synagogue 'Bayit B' next door to the hotel
GABA_B_receptor.mnemonic_link: GABA-B = 'Bayit B' (House B in Hebrew). Separate building emphasizes that GABA-B is structurally different (G-protein, not ion channel).
GABA_B_receptor.function_depiction: Baclofen prays here (spasticity treatment). GHB visits (illicit/narcolepsy).
GABA_B_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן GABA-B — מטבוטרופי (Gi → תעלות K⁺). 'בית-ב' סמוך למלון. Baclofen מתפלל שם = ספסטיות.

NMDA_receptor.category: Glutamate receptor — ligand-gated + voltage-gated (Mg²⁺ block). Ca²⁺ influx.
NMDA_receptor.symbol: Heavy iron door labeled 'NMDA' with horseshoe magnet wedged in lock
NMDA_receptor.mnemonic_link: Door = channel. Mr. Asparagus (NMDA = N-methyl-D-Aspartate) is the agonist. Magnet = Mg²⁺ block. Glycine pebble at his feet = required co-agonist. Chalk-white '2+' guests = Ca²⁺ entry.
NMDA_receptor.function_depiction: Three conditions for opening: 1) Asparagus present (glutamate/NMDA), 2) Glycine pebble present, 3) Neon sign flickers (depolarization) → magnet falls out. NMDA hypothesis of schizophrenia = rusty magnet, door never opens properly → negative symptoms.
NMDA_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן NMDA — גלוטמט יונוטרופי. דלת ברזל עם מגנט-מנעול (Mg²⁺). פתיחה דורשת 3 תנאים: גלוטמט/NMDA + Glycine + דה-פולריזציה. כשפתוח → Ca²⁺ נכנס → פלסטיות, learning.

Acetylcholine.category: Neurotransmitter — agonist for BOTH muscarinic AND nicotinic receptors
Acetylcholine.function_depiction: In Wonderland: the match lights the Mad Hatter's pipe (muscarinic activation). In Cigarette Theater: the same match lights the '42' and 'Lucky 7' cigarettes (nicotinic activation). One match = one ACh = two scenes (both receptor families share the same ligand).
Acetylcholine.hebrew_explanation: אצטיל-כולין — גפרור עץ נצמת ('אצית' עברית = להדליק). עובר בין סצנת Wonderland (mAChR) לסצנת Cigarette Theater (nAChR).

mu_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor μ — Gi (analgesia + euphoria + respiratory depression)
mu_opioid_receptor.symbol: Cow saying 'MOO', producing pails labeled Analgesia, Euphoria, Constipation, Resp. Depression, Miosis
mu_opioid_receptor.mnemonic_link: μ ≈ 'moo' — the sound a cow makes.
mu_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Full agonism (Morphine, Fentanyl, Heroin, Oxycodone, Codeine) = milkers extracting effect. Partial agonism (Buprenorphine) = ceiling-effect milker. Antagonism (Naloxone, Naltrexone) = chase milkers off → withdrawal.
mu_opioid_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן μ-opioid (Gi). פרה שאומרת 'MOO' (= μ) עם דליים: אנלגזיה / אופוריה / דיכוי נשימה / עצירות / מיוזה. Morphine, Fentanyl, Heroin = חולבים מלאים. Buprenorphine = חולב חלקי.

kappa_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor κ — Gi (dysphoria, sedation, diuresis)
kappa_opioid_receptor.mnemonic_link: κ = Kappa = K tag. Goats kick (dysphoria).
kappa_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Endogenous agonist = Dynorphin (sad farmer's tears). κ-ANTAGONISM is an emerging antidepressant target (Buprenorphine has κ-antagonist activity → mood lift).
kappa_opioid_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן κ-opioid (Gi). תיש בועט עם תווית 'K'. אגוניסט = דיספוריה. חסימת κ = טרגט אנטי-דיכאוני חדש (חלק ממנגנון Buprenorphine).

delta_opioid_receptor.category: Opioid receptor δ — Gi (less clinical, mood modulation in research)
delta_opioid_receptor.function_depiction: Endogenous agonist = Enkephalins. No clinically used δ-selective drugs (research stage).
delta_opioid_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן δ-opioid (Gi). מטוס Delta Airlines מעל החווה. אנקפלינים אנדוגניים. פחות קליני.

M1_receptor.symbol: White Rabbit clutching his '1 O'Clock' pocket watch, frantic about being late
M1_receptor.mnemonic_link: Pocket watch reads '1' = M1. Obsession with time = memory.
M1_receptor.function_depiction: Block (Atropine, Scopolamine, Benztropine, Diphenhydramine, TCAs at high doses) = Mad-as-a-Hatter delirium = the rabbit drops his watch and becomes the Mad Hatter.
M1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן M1 — מוסקריני (Gq, CNS, זיכרון). הארנב הלבן עם שעון '1 O'Clock'. חסימה (Atropine וכו') = Mad as a Hatter (דליריום).

M2_receptor.category: Muscarinic M2 — Gi, HEART (slows it via parasympathetic input)
M2_receptor.symbol: Queen of Hearts holding TWO '2 of Hearts' playing cards above her chest
M2_receptor.function_depiction: Block (Atropine) = Queen dizzy → tachycardia (loss of parasympathetic brake). Used clinically for symptomatic bradycardia.
M2_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן M2 — מוסקריני (Gi, לב). מלכת לבבות עם 2 קלפי 'Two of Hearts'. חסימה (Atropine) = ברדיקרדיה מתהפכת לטכיקרדיה.

M3_receptor.category: Muscarinic M3 — Gq, GLANDS + smooth muscle (secretions, GI, bladder, ciliary)
M3_receptor.symbol: Mad Hatter's tea table with 3 teacups overflowing — labeled saliva, tears, sweat
M3_receptor.function_depiction: Block = Dry as a Bone (no saliva/tears), Hot as a Hare (no sweat), Blind as a Bat (pupils dilated — iris constrictor is M3), urinary retention, ↓GI motility.
M3_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן M3 — מוסקריני (Gq, בלוטות + שריר חלק). שולחן ה-Mad Hatter עם 3 כוסות תה דולפות (רוק, דמעות, זיעה). חסימה = Dry as a Bone, Hot as a Hare, Blind as a Bat.

M4_receptor.category: Muscarinic M4 — Gi, CNS striatum (modulates dopamine release)
M4_receptor.symbol: Tweedledee at the corner of the party (less prominent)
M4_receptor.mnemonic_link: One of the lookalike twins (with M5) — pair for less-clinical receptors.
M4_receptor.function_depiction: Emerging antipsychotic target. Xanomeline (in KarXT, FDA-approved 2024) is an M1+M4 agonist — novel non-D2 antipsychotic.
M4_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן M4 — מוסקריני (Gi, סטריאטום). Tweedledee בפינה. טרגט אנטיפסיכוטי מתפתח (Xanomeline/KarXT 2024).

M5_receptor.category: Muscarinic M5 — Gq, CNS reward circuits (VTA)
M5_receptor.symbol: Tweedledum at the corner of the party
M5_receptor.function_depiction: Theoretical role in addiction reward. No clinical drugs target M5 selectively yet.
M5_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן M5 — מוסקריני (Gq, VTA reward). Tweedledum. תאוריה בהתמכרות, אין תרופות.

anticholinergic_toxidrome.category: Anticholinergic syndrome — muscarinic blockade clinical presentation
anticholinergic_toxidrome.symbol: The whole Wonderland scene running riot — Mad Hatter completely mad, Red Queen flushed and screaming, March Hare panting hot, teacups bone-dry, Cheshire Cat invisible (just dilated pupils glowing)
anticholinergic_toxidrome.mnemonic_link: Each toxic sign = one Wonderland character. Memorable 5-character constellation.
anticholinergic_toxidrome.function_depiction: MAD as a HATTER (M1 CNS delirium), RED as a BEET (vasodilation), HOT as a HARE (M3 anhidrosis), DRY as a BONE (M3 hypo-secretion), BLIND as a BAT (M3 mydriasis + cycloplegia). Plus urinary retention + tachycardia (M2). Treatment: physostigmine (cholinesterase inhibitor) + supportive.
anticholinergic_toxidrome.hebrew_explanation: תסמונת אנטיכולינרגית. כל Wonderland משתגעת: Mad as a Hatter (M1, דליריום), Red as a Beet (vasodilation), Hot as a Hare (M3 אין הזעה), Dry as a Bone (M3 יבש), Blind as a Bat (M3 אישונים מורחבים). טיפול: Physostigmine.

nAChR_alpha4_beta2.category: Nicotinic ACh receptor α4β2 — ligand-gated Na⁺/Ca²⁺ channel. Brain reward.
nAChR_alpha4_beta2.symbol: Branded cigarette labeled '42' (the answer to life, universe and everything)
nAChR_alpha4_beta2.function_depiction: Agonism (Nicotine) = full activation → dopamine in VTA → reward. Partial agonism (Varenicline) = half-cigarette → enough to satisfy craving but blocks full nicotine reward → smoking cessation.
nAChR_alpha4_beta2.hebrew_explanation: nAChR α4β2 — תעלה יונוטרופית CNS. סיגריית '42' (תשובה לחיים, ליקום, ולמה). מטרת Varenicline (אגוניסט חלקי).

nAChR_alpha7.category: Nicotinic ACh receptor α7 — Ca²⁺-permeable, cognition + schizophrenia hypothesis
nAChR_alpha7.symbol: Old wise grandpa smoking a 'Lucky 7' cigarette
nAChR_alpha7.function_depiction: Hypofunction in schizophrenia (sensory gating deficit, low CHRNA7 expression). Explains ~80% smoking rate in schizophrenia (self-medication of α7). Drugs targeting α7 are in development for cognitive symptoms.
nAChR_alpha7.hebrew_explanation: nAChR α7 — תעלה Ca²⁺-permeable, קוגניציה. סיגריית 'Lucky 7' של סבא חכם. היפו-תפקוד בסכיזופרניה (~80% מעשנים = self-medication).

H1_receptor.category: Histamine H1 — Gq (sedation, allergy, weight gain)
H1_receptor.symbol: Floor 1 living room — snoozing resident on a giant couch, allergy tissues nearby
H1_receptor.mnemonic_link: Floor 1 = ground level = where you collapse = sedation.
H1_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Diphenhydramine, Hydroxyzine, Mirtazapine, Quetiapine, Olanzapine, Doxepin low-dose) = sleep mask → sedation + weight gain. Many antipsychotics + atypical antidepressants block H1 = the primary cause of their sedation.
H1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן H1 — היסטמין (Gq). קומה 1 בית-H (סלון נמנום). חסימה (Diphenhydramine, Mirtazapine, Quetiapine, Olanzapine) = סדציה + עליה במשקל.

H2_receptor.category: Histamine H2 — Gs (gastric parietal cells → stomach acid)
H2_receptor.symbol: Floor 2 kitchen with pots labeled 'H2O' leaking stomach acid
H2_receptor.mnemonic_link: H2O = water = liquid stomach acid. '2' = H2.
H2_receptor.function_depiction: Antagonism (Famotidine, Ranitidine, Cimetidine) = lids on the pots → antacid effect. Cimetidine notable: CYP inhibitor, anti-androgen → gynecomastia.
H2_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן H2 — היסטמין (Gs, פריאטל גסטרי). קומה 2 (מטבח H2O). חסימה (Famotidine) = אנטאצידים.

H3_receptor.category: Histamine H3 — Gi (CNS autoreceptor for histamine; also modulates other NTs)
H3_receptor.symbol: Floor 3 study — autoreceptor professor dozing at his desk (he's controlling his own histamine release)
H3_receptor.mnemonic_link: H + 3 = study floor. Auto-receptor = self-feedback (professor controlling himself).
H3_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism = professor sleeps deeper → drowsy patient. Inverse agonism (Pitolisant — alarm clock) = wakes him → ↑histamine release → wakefulness. Pitolisant approved for narcolepsy + EDS.
H3_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן H3 — היסטמין (Gi, אוטו-רצפטור CNS). פרופסור נרדם על השולחן בקומה 3. Pitolisant = inverse agonist → ערות → טיפול בנרקולפסיה.

H4_receptor.category: Histamine H4 — Gi (immune cells; minimal psychiatric relevance)
H4_receptor.symbol: Floor 4 rooftop with immune-cell pigeons circling
H4_receptor.mnemonic_link: H + 4 = highest floor. Pigeons = immune cells.
H4_receptor.function_depiction: Inflammation modulation. Not a psychiatric target.
H4_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן H4 — היסטמין (Gi, תאי חיסון). גג בית-H עם יוני חיסון. לא פסיכיאטרי.

DAT.category: Dopamine transporter — reuptakes synaptic DA into the presynaptic terminal
DAT.symbol: A Jewish religious man (rabbi with payot and kippah) gathering scattered dopamine ore back home
DAT.mnemonic_link: DAT = דת (Hebrew: 'religion'). 'Religious man' = איש דת. Collecting ore back home = reuptake.
DAT.function_depiction: Inhibition (Methylphenidate, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Bupropion) = blindfold on the rabbi → can't see scattered ore → dopamine pools in synapse → enhanced postsynaptic effect.
DAT.hebrew_explanation: מובל דופמין — איש דת (רב חרדי עם פאות) במכרה DOPA-MINE אוסף עפרת דופמין שפוזרה חזרה הביתה. דת = DAT (משחק עברי). חסימה (Methylphenidate, Amphetamine, Cocaine, Bupropion) = כיסוי עיניים לרב.

VMAT2.category: Vesicular monoamine transporter 2 — packages monoamines (DA, NE, 5-HT) into vesicles
VMAT2.symbol: Yoga mat labeled 'V-MAT 2' — monoamines rest on it before vesicular release
VMAT2.function_depiction: Inhibition (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine) = mat is stolen → monoamines never packaged → presynaptic depletion. Treats Tardive Dyskinesia + Huntington's chorea.
VMAT2.hebrew_explanation: מובל ווסיקולרי 2 — מזרון יוגה 'V-MAT 2' באולם מנוחה. מונואמינים שוכבים עליו לפני שחרור. גנבים (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Tetrabenazine) = TD treatment.

sigma1_receptor.category: Sigma-1 — chaperone protein at the ER (mood, neuroprotection)
sigma1_receptor.symbol: Sentry guard with 'S-1' badge at the door of the endoplasmic reticulum
sigma1_receptor.mnemonic_link: 'S' = sigma + '1' = subtype. Guard = chaperone (escorts misfolded proteins).
sigma1_receptor.function_depiction: Agonism (Fluvoxamine — uniquely strong among SSRIs; Dextromethorphan; some antidepressants) = guard escorts more clients → mood lift + anti-OCD/anxiety. Explains Fluvoxamine's particular efficacy in OCD beyond SERT block.
sigma1_receptor.hebrew_explanation: קולטן σ1 — chaperone protein ב-ER (מצב רוח, ניאו-פרוטקציה). סנטרי 'S-1'. Fluvoxamine אגוניסט ייחודי בקרב SSRI (עוצמת OCD/חרדה). גם Dextromethorphan.

VTA.category: Ventral Tegmental Area — midbrain dopamine source (mesolimbic + mesocortical)
VTA.symbol: The mine SUPERVISOR'S OFFICE — VTA chairman dispatches carts to two destinations
VTA.mnemonic_link: VTA = the management hub of DOPA-MINE Co.
VTA.function_depiction: Dispatches mesolimbic carts (to limbic 'casino') and mesocortical carts (to cortical 'café'). Hyperactivity → too much to limbic (psychosis). Hypoactivity → too little to cortex (negative symptoms).
VTA.hebrew_explanation: Ventral Tegmental Area — משרד יו"ר ב-DOPA-MINE. מקור מסולימבי + מסוקורטיקלי. היפראקטיביות = פסיכוזה; היפו = תסמינים שליליים.

substantia_nigra_pars_compacta.category: Substantia nigra pars compacta — nigrostriatal dopamine source
substantia_nigra_pars_compacta.symbol: A literally BLACK mine shaft — substantia NIGRA = 'black substance'
substantia_nigra_pars_compacta.mnemonic_link: Latin: nigra = black. Compacta = densely packed neurons.
substantia_nigra_pars_compacta.function_depiction: Sends nigrostriatal carts to motor striatum. Neurodegeneration → Parkinson's disease (the black shaft caves in). D2 blockade → drug-induced parkinsonism (EXTRA pyramid hats around the motor section).
substantia_nigra_pars_compacta.hebrew_explanation: Substantia Nigra — פיר 'שחור' (nigra = שחור) במכרה. מקור ניגרוסטריאטלי. ניוון = פרקינסון; חסימת D2 = פרקינסוניזם תרופתי.

mesolimbic_pathway.category: Dopamine pathway — VTA → Nucleus Accumbens (reward, positive symptoms)
mesolimbic_pathway.symbol: Train tracks marked 'MESO-LIMB' running from VTA supervisor's office to a CASINO (nucleus accumbens — reward gambling)
mesolimbic_pathway.mnemonic_link: Meso = middle, Limbic = emotional. Casino = reward.
mesolimbic_pathway.function_depiction: Hyperactivity = train overloaded with carts → POSITIVE SYMPTOMS of schizophrenia (delusions, hallucinations). Stimulants also flood this track → stimulant psychosis. Reward of addiction = casino lights flashing.
mesolimbic_pathway.hebrew_explanation: מסלול מסולימבי — קווי רכבת VTA→ קזינו (NAc). היפראקטיביות = סימפטומים חיוביים בסכיזופרניה. גם reward של התמכרות.

mesocortical_pathway.category: Dopamine pathway — VTA → PFC (cognition, negative symptoms when low)
mesocortical_pathway.symbol: Train tracks marked 'MESO-CORT' running from VTA office to a fancy intellectual COFFEE SHOP atop the PFC
mesocortical_pathway.function_depiction: HYPOactivity (track is empty) = NEGATIVE SYMPTOMS of schizophrenia (avolition, alogia, flat affect). Difficult-to-treat — D2 blockade also dampens this track.
mesocortical_pathway.hebrew_explanation: מסלול מסוקורטיקלי — VTA → בית-קפה אינטלקטואלי (PFC). היפואקטיביות = סימפטומים שליליים. קשה לטפל.

nigrostriatal_pathway.category: Dopamine pathway — substantia nigra → striatum (motor control)
nigrostriatal_pathway.symbol: Train tracks marked 'NIGRO-STRIA' from the black mine shaft to a giant gear-shaped chamber (striatum)
nigrostriatal_pathway.mnemonic_link: Nigro = black source; Striatum = gear chamber (striped striatum).
nigrostriatal_pathway.function_depiction: Hypoactivity (cells die in Parkinson's, or D2 blockade by antipsychotics) → EXTRA pyramid hats spawn = EPS. Hyperactivity → chorea/hyperkinetic disorders.
nigrostriatal_pathway.hebrew_explanation: מסלול ניגרוסטריאטלי — substantia nigra → תא גלגלי-שיניים (סטריאטום). היפו = EPS (פירמידות), פרקינסון.

tuberoinfundibular_pathway.category: Dopamine pathway — arcuate nucleus → pituitary (prolactin inhibition)
tuberoinfundibular_pathway.symbol: Tubes labeled 'TUBE-INFUNDIBULAR' running from hypothalamus to a giant MILK PUMP
tuberoinfundibular_pathway.mnemonic_link: Tubero = the tubes. Infundibular = funnel (pituitary stalk).
tuberoinfundibular_pathway.function_depiction: Normal: DA TONIC-inhibits prolactin secretion. D2 blockade (typical antipsychotics, paliperidone, risperidone) → tubes blocked → milk pump leaks UNCONTROLLED → HYPERPROLACTINEMIA (galactorrhea, amenorrhea, gynecomastia, sexual dysfunction).
tuberoinfundibular_pathway.hebrew_explanation: מסלול טוברואינפונדיבולרי — היפותלמוס → היפופיזה. DA תונית-מעכב פרולקטין. חסימת D2 = הצפת פרולקטין (galactorrhea, amenorrhea).

raphe_nuclei.category: Brainstem 5-HT source — seam of midline nuclei
raphe_nuclei.symbol: Persian-rug weaving workshop along the brainstem seam — weavers produce 5-HT yarn
raphe_nuclei.mnemonic_link: Raphe = 'seam' in Greek. Tapestry = woven projection everywhere.
raphe_nuclei.function_depiction: Source of essentially all CNS serotonin → projections to cortex, limbic, hypothalamus, spinal cord. SSRI/SNRI/TCA action on terminals downstream. Old loom won't start for weeks = SSRI onset delay.
raphe_nuclei.hebrew_explanation: גרעיני raphe (תפר במרכז הגזע מוחי) — סדנת שטיחים פרסיים. מקור כל הסרוטונין במוח. SSRI/SNRI/TCA פעולה בטרמינלים. דחיית הופעת = הלום ישן.

locus_coeruleus.category: Brainstem NE source — the 'blue spot' (locus coeruleus)
locus_coeruleus.symbol: A Doctor-Who-style BLUE police box in the rostral pons, phone wires fanning out
locus_coeruleus.function_depiction: Source of essentially all CNS norepinephrine. Hyperactive in panic, PTSD, opioid withdrawal (red light flashing). Clonidine/Guanfacine = friendly dispatcher (α2 autoreceptor) calms the box. Propranolol = blocks downstream effects. Prazosin = blocks α1 effects on nightmares.
locus_coeruleus.hebrew_explanation: Locus Coeruleus — תא טלפון משטרתי כחול ('כתם כחול'). מקור כל ה-NE במוח. היפראקטיבי בפניקה, PTSD, גמילה. Clonidine/Guanfacine = מרגיעים.

tuberomammillary_nucleus.symbol: Mammary cows pumping histamine in the posterior hypothalamus
tuberomammillary_nucleus.function_depiction: Sole source of CNS histamine → wakefulness. Hypofunction = narcolepsy connection (Pitolisant boosts it via H3 inverse agonism). H1-blocking drugs = sedation downstream.
tuberomammillary_nucleus.hebrew_explanation: Tuberomammillary — פרות מימרי בהיפותלמוס. מקור כל ההיסטמין במוח. ערות. Pitolisant מגביר (H3 inverse agonist).

basal_nucleus_meynert.category: Basal forebrain ACh source for cortex (memory)
basal_nucleus_meynert.symbol: A wise old MYNAH bird in the basal forebrain whispering memories to cortex
basal_nucleus_meynert.function_depiction: Cortical cholinergic projections. Degenerates in Alzheimer's (skipped per user). Anticholinergic syndrome → 'Mad as a Hatter' = silencing the Mynah → delirium.
basal_nucleus_meynert.hebrew_explanation: גרעין Meynert — ציפור מינה חכמה ב-basal forebrain. מקור אצטיל-כולין לקליפת המוח. ניוון באלצהיימר.

dorsal_raphe.category: Specific raphe nucleus — primary 5-HT source for cortex
dorsal_raphe.symbol: The DORSAL (top) weaving station of the Persian-rug workshop
dorsal_raphe.mnemonic_link: Dorsal = top. Most clinically referenced raphe subnucleus.
dorsal_raphe.function_depiction: Main 5-HT input to PFC. 5-HT1A autoreceptors here = SSRI delay-of-onset mechanism.
dorsal_raphe.hebrew_explanation: Dorsal raphe — תחנת האריגה העליונה. עיקר ה-5-HT לקליפת המוח. 5-HT1A autoreceptors כאן = מנגנון השהיית SSRI.

pedunculopontine_nucleus.symbol: A foot-pedal organ at the pons-midbrain junction, played to keep the brain alert
pedunculopontine_nucleus.function_depiction: REM sleep regulation + arousal. Targeted in Parkinson's DBS for gait freezing.
pedunculopontine_nucleus.hebrew_explanation: PPN — דוושה אורגנית. ערות + REM. מטרת DBS בפרקינסון לקיפאון הליכה.

prefrontal_cortex.symbol: Glass-walled CEO OFFICE at the front of a skyscraper. PFC = 'Pretty Fancy Corner-office'.
prefrontal_cortex.mnemonic_link: PreFrontal Cortex = front of brain = the CEO suite.
prefrontal_cortex.function_depiction: Working memory, planning, inhibition. ↓DA mesocortical = empty office (negative symptoms). α2A agonists (Guanfacine) = strict secretary keeping the CEO focused (ADHD). Alcohol/BZDs = drunk CEO making bad decisions.
prefrontal_cortex.hebrew_explanation: PFC — משרד מנכ"ל מזוגג בחזית. תפקוד ביצועי, זיכרון עבודה, עיכוב. ↓DA מסוקורטיקלי = משרד ריק = סימפטומים שליליים.

anterior_cingulate_cortex.symbol: A police DETECTIVE at the front of a courthouse, watching for contradictions
anterior_cingulate_cortex.mnemonic_link: Anterior CINGulate → CINGulate = detective sniffing inconsistency.
anterior_cingulate_cortex.function_depiction: Conflict detection, error monitoring, social cognition. Hyperactive in OCD (over-detecting errors). Hypoactive in depression. DBS target for treatment-resistant depression.
anterior_cingulate_cortex.hebrew_explanation: ACC — בלש שמרחרח סתירות. ניטור קונפליקטים, ויסות רגשי. היפראקטיבי ב-OCD; היפואקטיבי בדיכאון. מטרת DBS לדיכאון עמיד.

orbitofrontal_cortex.symbol: A JUDGE in robes weighing scales with money on one side, ethics on the other, sitting above the EYE SOCKETS (orbits)
orbitofrontal_cortex.mnemonic_link: ORBITO = orbit = eye socket. Judge weighs value/morality.
orbitofrontal_cortex.function_depiction: Damage = disinhibition, poor decision-making (Phineas Gage). OCD = hyperactive judge in a loop. Klüver-Bucy = OFC + temporal damage = inappropriate behavior.
orbitofrontal_cortex.hebrew_explanation: OFC — שופט מעל הארובות (orbits = ארובות עיניים). שיפוט ערך + מוסר. פגיעה = Phineas Gage (פיזור עיכוב). OCD = שופט תקוע בלולאה.

dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex.symbol: A LIBRARIAN organizing books at the side of the CEO office
dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex.mnemonic_link: DorsoLateral = top-side of PFC. Books = working memory.
dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex.function_depiction: rTMS depression target (left dlPFC stimulation, right dlPFC inhibition). Hypoactive in schizophrenia (negative symptoms).
dorsolateral_prefrontal_cortex.hebrew_explanation: dlPFC — ספרן בצד המשרד. זיכרון עבודה, בקרה קוגניטיבית. מטרת rTMS לדיכאון (גירוי שמאל). היפואקטיבי בסכיזופרניה.

ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex.symbol: A meditation cushion at the BOTTOM-CENTER of the PFC office
ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex.function_depiction: Default Mode Network hub. Hyperactive rumination in depression. Mindfulness/CBT modulate vmPFC.
ventromedial_prefrontal_cortex.hebrew_explanation: vmPFC — כרית מדיטציה בתחתית המשרד. ויסות רגשי, הפנמה. רכזת ב-Default Mode Network. רומינציה דיכאונית.

amygdala.symbol: An ALMOND-shaped panic alarm (amygdala = Greek for 'almond')
amygdala.mnemonic_link: Amygdala = almond literally. Always-on threat scanner.
amygdala.function_depiction: Hyperactive in PTSD/anxiety = alarm constantly ringing. SSRIs dampen the alarm over weeks. β-blockers (Propranolol) can blunt emotional memory consolidation. Klüver-Bucy = bilateral amygdala damage = fearlessness.
amygdala.hebrew_explanation: אמיגדלה — אזעקה בצורת שקד (amygdala = שקד ביוונית). זיהוי איום + זיכרון רגשי. היפראקטיבית ב-PTSD/חרדה. Klüver-Bucy = פגיעה דו-צדדית.

hippocampus.symbol: A literal SEAHORSE (hippocampus = Greek for 'seahorse') with a TINY MAP
hippocampus.function_depiction: Shrinks in chronic stress (cortisol toxic), depression, PTSD. SSRI/exercise = neurogenesis (seahorse grows). Memory loss with BZDs (especially α5 block, Midazolam). Hippocampal sclerosis = temporal-lobe epilepsy + depression.
hippocampus.hebrew_explanation: היפוקמפוס — סוסון ים עם מפת מסלולים (hippocampus = סוסון ים). זיכרון דקלרטיבי + ניווט מרחבי. מצטמק בלחץ כרוני. נוירוגנזה מ-SSRI/ספורט.

basal_ganglia.symbol: A complex GEAR SYSTEM at the base of the brain — striated stripes visible
basal_ganglia.mnemonic_link: Basal = bottom. Ganglia = clusters of gears.
basal_ganglia.function_depiction: Contains: caudate, putamen (=striatum), globus pallidus (internal/external), subthalamic nucleus, substantia nigra. Hypofunction = Parkinson's. Hyperfunction = chorea (Huntington's). OCD = caudate gear stuck on repeat.
basal_ganglia.hebrew_explanation: Basal Ganglia — מערכת גלגלי שיניים בבסיס המוח. בקרת תנועה + הרגלים. כולל: caudate, putamen (= striatum), globus pallidus, STN, substantia nigra.

striatum_caudate_putamen.category: Striatum (Caudate + Putamen) — input to basal ganglia
striatum_caudate_putamen.symbol: Striped (striated) sweater worn by a worker — caudate = 'C-shaped tail', putamen = 'shell'
striatum_caudate_putamen.mnemonic_link: Striatum = striated. Caudate = tail. Putamen = shell.
striatum_caudate_putamen.function_depiction: Receives nigrostriatal DA + cortical glutamate input. D2 blockade in striatum → EPS. Hyperdopaminergic → tics, OCD, hyperkinetics.
striatum_caudate_putamen.hebrew_explanation: סטריאטום (caudate + putamen) — סוודר פסים שלובש פועל. ה-input של ה-basal ganglia. חסימת D2 כאן = EPS. היפר-DA = טיקים, OCD.

globus_pallidus.symbol: PALE round bouncer at the exit of the basal ganglia gear system
globus_pallidus.function_depiction: DBS target for Parkinson's (GPi stimulation). Inhibitory output to thalamus.
globus_pallidus.hebrew_explanation: Globus Pallidus — באוונצ'ר חיוור עגול ביציאת מערכת הגלגלי שיניים. מטרת DBS לפרקינסון.

subthalamic_nucleus.category: STN — basal ganglia indirect pathway hub
subthalamic_nucleus.symbol: A small but mighty engine UNDER the thalamus
subthalamic_nucleus.function_depiction: DBS target #1 for Parkinson's. Hyperactivity = hemiballismus (one-sided flinging).
subthalamic_nucleus.hebrew_explanation: STN — מנוע קטן אך עוצמתי מתחת לתלמוס. מטרת DBS #1 לפרקינסון. היפראקטיביות = hemiballismus.

thalamus.symbol: A grand CENTRAL TRAIN STATION at the brain core, lines coming and going everywhere
thalamus.function_depiction: All sensory (except smell) and motor passes through. Thalamocortical oscillations disrupted in schizophrenia. Sleep spindles (α1-GABA in thalamus) → sleep depth.
thalamus.hebrew_explanation: תלמוס — תחנת רכבת מרכזית גרנדיוזית. ממסר חושי (חוץ מריח) + מוטורי. פגיעה ב-thalamocortical oscillations = סכיזופרניה.

hypothalamus.symbol: A THERMOSTAT/control panel UNDER the thalamus station
hypothalamus.function_depiction: Sleep (suprachiasmatic n.), appetite (arcuate, paraventricular), temperature, HPA axis. Lesions cause classical syndromes (Kleine-Levin = appetite + sleep + sex).
hypothalamus.hebrew_explanation: היפותלמוס — תרמוסטט מתחת לתלמוס. שינה (SCN), תיאבון (arcuate), חום, ציר HPA.

insula.symbol: A small ISLAND tucked between the temporal and frontal lobes
insula.function_depiction: Bodily awareness (interoception). Hyperactive in panic disorder (over-noticing heart). Addiction craving signal. Disgust + empathy.
insula.hebrew_explanation: אינסולה — אי קטן בין האונה הטמפורלית לפרונטלית (insula = אי בלטינית). מודעות גופנית (interoception). היפראקטיבית בפניקה.

cerebellum.symbol: A LITTLE BRAIN hanging at the back ('cerebellum' = little brain)
cerebellum.function_depiction: Motor coordination. Also: cognitive timing, language. Lithium toxicity = cerebellar damage (ataxia). Alcoholism = cerebellar atrophy → broad-based gait.
cerebellum.hebrew_explanation: צרבלום — 'מוח קטן' בעורף (cerebellum = מוח קטן בלטינית). קואורדינציה מוטורית + תזמון קוגניטיבי. רעלת ליתיום פוגעת = אטקסיה.

default_mode_network.symbol: A coffee-shop COMMITTEE of brain regions chatting when nothing else is going on (vmPFC, posterior cingulate, angular gyrus)
default_mode_network.mnemonic_link: Default Mode = idle mode = daydreaming committee.
default_mode_network.function_depiction: Hyperactive in depression (rumination, self-criticism). Psilocybin/ketamine 'reset' the DMN — proposed antidepressant mechanism. Mindfulness reduces DMN activity.
default_mode_network.hebrew_explanation: DMN — ועד קופי-שופ של אזורי מוח (vmPFC, PCC, angular). פעיל ב-rest = חלום-בהקיץ. היפראקטיבי בדיכאון (רומינציה).

nucleus_accumbens.symbol: A CASINO with slot machines flashing — the mesolimbic train's destination
nucleus_accumbens.function_depiction: Addiction substrate. Stimulant + opioid + nicotine all flood DA here. DBS target for treatment-resistant depression + OCD.
nucleus_accumbens.hebrew_explanation: Nucleus Accumbens (NAc) — קזינו עם מכונות פוקר. מרכז התגמול. כל ההתמכרויות מציפות DA כאן.

neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome.symbol: The mesolimbic D2 barrier is SLAMMED SHUT — all workers turn into RIGID PYRAMID STATUES, the mine catches FIRE (hyperthermia), and a heart monitor shows wild swings
neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome.mnemonic_link: NMS = Neuroleptic Massive Shutdown of DA system.
neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome.function_depiction: Caused by: any antipsychotic (esp. high-potency 1st-gen). 4-Symptom rule: Fever + Encephalopathy (altered mental status) + Vital instability + Elevated enzymes (↑CK >1000). Treatment: STOP antipsychotic, supportive cooling, dantrolene/bromocriptine, ICU. DDx: serotonin syndrome (clonus vs. rigidity).
neuroleptic_malignant_syndrome.hebrew_explanation: NMS — תסמונת ממאירה ניורולפטית. מצב חירום: היפרתרמיה + נוקשות שרירים + אי-יציבות אוטונומית + ↑CK. גורם: אנטיפסיכוטיים (במיוחד דור 1 פוטנטיים). טיפול: הפסקת תרופה + Dantrolene/Bromocriptine + טיפול תומך. DDx: serotonin syndrome (clonus vs rigidity).

serotonin_syndrome.symbol: The Persian-rug Raphe workshop in FRENZY — looms spinning out of control, weavers shaking with CLONUS (rhythmic limbs), hot from overdrive
serotonin_syndrome.function_depiction: Caused by: SSRI/SNRI/MAOI combos, Tramadol + SSRI, Linezolid + SSRI, MAOI + cheese (tyramine — but that's hypertensive crisis, different). HUNTER CRITERIA: spontaneous CLONUS, inducible clonus + agitation/diaphoresis, ocular clonus + agitation, tremor + hyperreflexia, hypertonia + temp >38 + clonus. Treatment: STOP serotonergic, supportive, CYPROHEPTADINE (5-HT2A antagonist). DDx vs. NMS: clonus + hyperreflexia (5-HT) vs. rigidity + ↑CK (NMS).
serotonin_syndrome.hebrew_explanation: תסמונת סרוטונרגית — clonus + היפר-רפלקסיה + agitation + autonomic + חום. גורם: SSRI+MAOI, Tramadol+SSRI, Linezolid+SSRI. Hunter criteria. טיפול: הפסקת תרופה + Cyproheptadine. DDx: NMS (clonus = serotonin, rigidity = NMS).

EPS_acute_dystonia.category: Acute dystonic reaction — sudden muscle spasm from D2 block
EPS_acute_dystonia.symbol: A worker FROZEN MID-STEP with neck CRANED upward (oculogyric crisis), tongue out
EPS_acute_dystonia.mnemonic_link: Within hours-days of antipsychotic, esp. young male.
EPS_acute_dystonia.function_depiction: Tx: IM Benztropine 1-2mg or IM Diphenhydramine 25-50mg. Resolves within minutes.
EPS_acute_dystonia.hebrew_explanation: דיסטוניה אקוטית — עווית שרירים פתאומית (oculogyric crisis, torticollis). תוך שעות-ימים מאנטיפסיכוטיק, במיוחד בגברים צעירים. טיפול: Benztropine IM 1-2mg או Diphenhydramine IM 25-50mg.

EPS_akathisia.symbol: Workers PACING back and forth, unable to sit still, even though they want to
EPS_akathisia.function_depiction: Sense of inner restlessness + objective movements. Links to SUICIDALITY warnings. Tx: ↓antipsychotic dose, switch (Aripiprazole common offender), Propranolol 10-20mg TID, BZD, Mirtazapine.
EPS_akathisia.hebrew_explanation: אקתיזיה — תחושת אי-שקט פנימית + תנועות חיצוניות. 'A-kathisia' = 'לא-יושב' ביוונית. קשור לסיכון אובדנות. טיפול: ↓מינון, Propranolol, BZD, Mirtazapine.

EPS_parkinsonism.symbol: Workers move in SLOW MOTION, hunched posture, mask-like faces, tremor
EPS_parkinsonism.mnemonic_link: Like real Parkinson's, but caused by D2 block (not cell death).
EPS_parkinsonism.function_depiction: Bradykinesia + rigidity + tremor + masked facies. Tx: ↓dose, anticholinergic (Benztropine), Amantadine. Reversible (vs. real Parkinson's).
EPS_parkinsonism.hebrew_explanation: פרקינסוניזם תרופתי — bradykinesia + נוקשות + רעד + פנים מסיכה. דמוי פרקינסון אבל הפיך. טיפול: ↓מינון, Benztropine, Amantadine.

tardive_dyskinesia.symbol: Workers with chronically TWITCHY FACES, chewing-like jaw movements, lip-smacking — appears AFTER prolonged blockade
tardive_dyskinesia.function_depiction: Risk ↑ with: years of 1st-gen exposure, female, elderly, diabetes. AIMS scale screening. Tx: switch to Clozapine/Quetiapine (lowest TD risk), VMAT2 inhibitors (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine). Often IRREVERSIBLE.
tardive_dyskinesia.hebrew_explanation: טרדיב דיסקינזיה — תנועות פה-לסת בלתי רצוניות מאוחרות. סיכון ↑ עם שנות חשיפה לדור 1. AIMS scale screening. טיפול: מעבר ל-Clozapine/Quetiapine + VMAT2 inhibitors (Valbenazine, Deutetrabenazine).

hyperprolactinemia.category: Hyperprolactinemia — D2 blockade of tuberoinfundibular pathway
hyperprolactinemia.symbol: The MILK PUMP at the pituitary section LEAKS UNCONTROLLED — milk everywhere
hyperprolactinemia.mnemonic_link: DA tonically inhibits prolactin. Block DA → prolactin floods.
hyperprolactinemia.function_depiction: Sx: galactorrhea, amenorrhea, gynecomastia, sexual dysfunction, osteoporosis (long-term). Worst offenders: Risperidone, Paliperidone, Haloperidol. Sparing: Aripiprazole (partial agonist), Quetiapine, Clozapine.
hyperprolactinemia.hebrew_explanation: היפרפרולקטינמיה — חסימת D2 במסלול טוברואינפונדיבולרי → פרולקטין ↑. סימפטומים: galactorrhea, אמנוריאה, גינקומסטיה, dysfunction מיני, אוסטיאופורוזיס. גרועים: Risperidone, Paliperidone, Haloperidol. מינימליים: Aripiprazole, Quetiapine, Clozapine.

metabolic_syndrome.category: Metabolic syndrome — antipsychotic-induced weight gain + dyslipidemia + T2DM
metabolic_syndrome.symbol: The Olympic athlete (Olanzapine character) gorging on pizza + sleeping under the Quiet Pine — surrounded by olives (oil) and a glucose meter showing 250
metabolic_syndrome.function_depiction: Risk ranking: Olanzapine > Clozapine > Quetiapine > Risperidone > Paliperidone > Aripiprazole > Ziprasidone > Lurasidone (lowest). Annual fasting glucose + lipid panel + waist circumference monitoring required.
metabolic_syndrome.hebrew_explanation: תסמונת מטבולית — עליה במשקל + דיסליפידמיה + T2DM. חסימת H1 + 5-HT2C משולבת. סיכון: Olanzapine > Clozapine > Quetiapine > Risperidone > ...> Lurasidone. ניטור שנתי: גלוקוז, ליפידים, מותן.

QT_prolongation.symbol: An EKG strip with the QT interval STRETCHED LONG — like a rubber band about to snap (into torsades de pointes)
QT_prolongation.function_depiction: Major offenders: Methadone, Ziprasidone, IV Haloperidol, TCAs, Citalopram (dose-dependent), some MAOIs. Risk factors: hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia, bradycardia, female. Baseline + follow-up EKG when stacking risk.
QT_prolongation.hebrew_explanation: QT הארכה — סיכון לסוג של arrhythmia (torsades de pointes). גרועים: Methadone, Ziprasidone, IV Haloperidol, TCAs, Citalopram (תלוי מינון). גורמי סיכון: היפו-K, היפו-Mg, ברדיקרדיה. ניטור: EKG בסיס + מעקב.

agranulocytosis_clozapine.symbol: White blood cell soldiers VANISHING — body without defenders. The Z-key from clozapine sits next to them.
agranulocytosis_clozapine.function_depiction: Risk 1-2% over years. MANDATORY ANC monitoring: weekly × 6 mo, biweekly × next 6 mo, monthly thereafter. REMS program in US. Other offenders (rare): Carbamazepine, Phenytoin, Mirtazapine.
agranulocytosis_clozapine.hebrew_explanation: אגרנולוציטוזה — דלדול נויטרופילים, אופייני ל-Clozapine. סיכון 1-2% במשך שנים. ניטור ANC חובה: שבועי × 6 ח', דו-שבועי × 6 ח', חודשי לאחר מכן. גם: Carbamazepine, Mirtazapine (נדיר).

SJS_TEN.category: Stevens-Johnson Syndrome / TEN — severe skin reaction
SJS_TEN.symbol: The Lamb (Lamotrigine) covered in PEELING RED RASH — skin falling off in sheets
SJS_TEN.function_depiction: Drugs at highest risk: Lamotrigine (slow titration crucial!), Carbamazepine (esp. HLA-B*1502 in Asian descent — test before starting), Phenobarbital, Phenytoin. Mortality high. Treatment: STOP drug, ICU.
SJS_TEN.hebrew_explanation: SJS / TEN — תגובת עור חמורה (גליפת עור). תרופות בסיכון גבוה: Lamotrigine (טיטרציה איטית!), Carbamazepine (HLA-B*1502 באסיינים — בדיקה לפני התחלה), Phenobarbital, Phenytoin. תמותה גבוהה. טיפול: עצירת תרופה + ICU.

SIADH_hyponatremia.symbol: The bread-maze (Carbamazepine) FLOODED with water — patient drowning in low sodium
SIADH_hyponatremia.function_depiction: Offenders: Carbamazepine, Oxcarbazepine (more than Carba!), SSRIs (esp. in elderly), Antipsychotics (rare). Sx: confusion, headache, seizures if severe. Check Na in elderly within 2 weeks of starting.
SIADH_hyponatremia.hebrew_explanation: SIADH תרופתי — היפונתרמיה. תרופות: Carbamazepine, Oxcarbazepine (יותר!), SSRI (במיוחד קשישים), אנטיפסיכוטיים נדיר. סימפטומים: בלבול, כאב ראש, פרכוסים. בדיקת Na תוך שבועיים מהתחלה בקשישים.

hepatotoxicity.symbol: A liver DANGLING ON THE EDGE — labeled with offending drugs
hepatotoxicity.function_depiction: High-risk: Valproate (esp. pediatric <2y, in mitochondrial disease — black box), Nefazodone (withdrawn US), Disulfiram, Naltrexone (high doses), MAOIs. Check LFTs at baseline + periodically.
hepatotoxicity.hebrew_explanation: רעלת כבד תרופתית. גבוה: Valproate (במיוחד פדיאטרי <2 שנה, מחלות מיטוכונדריאליות — black box), Nefazodone, Disulfiram, Naltrexone (במינונים גבוהים), MAOI. ניטור LFT בסיס + תקופתי.

suicidality_warning.category: FDA suicidality warning — paradoxical risk in young patients
suicidality_warning.symbol: A BLACK BOX with skull-and-crossbones on antidepressant pill bottles, specifically for <25y
suicidality_warning.mnemonic_link: FDA's black-box warning is literal in this symbol.
suicidality_warning.function_depiction: Risk increase in first 1-2 months of SSRI/SNRI use in <25y. Warn families. Close monitoring. ABSOLUTE risk small; benefit usually outweighs.
suicidality_warning.hebrew_explanation: אזהרת FDA — סיכון אובדנות פרדוקסלי בצעירים. עליה בסיכון בחודשים 1-2 של SSRI/SNRI בגיל <25. אזהרת black-box. ליווי קרוב במשפחה. הסיכון המוחלט קטן, התועלת בדרך כלל גוברת.

discontinuation_syndrome_FINISH.symbol: Patient suddenly OFF the SERT-postal-route — body experiences withdrawal: dizzy, flu-like, electric-shocks ('brain zaps'), GI
discontinuation_syndrome_FINISH.mnemonic_link: FINISH mnemonic: Flu-like, Insomnia, Nausea, Imbalance, Sensory disturbance, Hyperarousal.
discontinuation_syndrome_FINISH.function_depiction: Worst with: Paroxetine, Venlafaxine (short t½). Best tolerated: Fluoxetine (long t½ self-tapers). Tx: re-start + slow taper. NOT relapse (timing differs).
discontinuation_syndrome_FINISH.hebrew_explanation: תסמונת הפסקת SSRI — הפסקה חדה → היפו-סרוטונין. FINISH: Flu-like, Insomnia, Nausea, Imbalance, Sensory disturbance (electric shocks/'brain zaps'), Hyperarousal. הגרוע: Paroxetine, Venlafaxine. הקל: Fluoxetine (t½ ארוך). טיפול: חזרה + טיטרציה איטית.

lithium_toxicity.symbol: The Li-ion battery OVER-CHARGED, smoking, swelling — tremor → ataxia → confusion → seizures → coma
lithium_toxicity.function_depiction: Mild (1.5-2.0): tremor coarse, N/V, diarrhea. Moderate (2.0-2.5): ataxia, confusion. Severe (>2.5): seizures, dialysis indicated. Triggers: dehydration, NSAIDs, ACE-I/ARB, diuretics (thiazides), renal disease. Annual TSH + Cr.
lithium_toxicity.hebrew_explanation: רעלת ליתיום — חלון טיפולי צר. קל (1.5-2.0): רעד, GI; בינוני (2.0-2.5): אטקסיה, בלבול; קשה (>2.5): פרכוסים, dialysis נדרש. טריגרים: התייבשות, NSAID, ACE-I/ARB, thiazides, מחלת כליה. ניטור: רמה, TSH, Cr שנתיים.

lithium_hypothyroid_DI.symbol: Battery cables wrapped around a SLOW THYROID (goiter) and a DRY/THIRSTY KIDNEY
lithium_hypothyroid_DI.function_depiction: Hypothyroidism (10-20% over years) — TSH q6-12mo, supplement with levothyroxine. Nephrogenic DI (polyuria, polydipsia) — Amiloride blocks Li uptake into collecting duct.
lithium_hypothyroid_DI.hebrew_explanation: ליתיום → היפותירואידיזם + סוכרת תפלה נפרוגנית. היפותירואידיזם: 10-20% במשך שנים → TSH q6-12mo + Levothyroxine. נפרוגנית DI (פוליאוריה): Amiloride חוסם כניסת Li לאיסוף.

priapism_trazodone.symbol: A traffic 'TRACK + ZONE' sign labeled 'STAYED TOO LONG' — emergency!
priapism_trazodone.mnemonic_link: Trazodone's notorious risk via α1 blockade.
priapism_trazodone.function_depiction: Rare but emergency (>4 hr = surgical urology). Warn male patients. Also reported with: Risperidone (α1 block), Chlorpromazine, rare with others.
priapism_trazodone.hebrew_explanation: Priapism — זיקפה מתמשכת וכואבת מחסימת α1. Trazodone הקלאסי. >4 שעות = חירום אורולוגי. גם: Risperidone, Chlorpromazine. הזהר זכרים.

sexual_dysfunction_SSRI.category: Sexual dysfunction — common SSRI side effect
sexual_dysfunction_SSRI.symbol: A 'CLOSED' sign on the bedroom door + sad lover — SSRI dampens libido + delays climax
sexual_dysfunction_SSRI.function_depiction: 30-70% on SSRI. ↓libido, anorgasmia, delayed ejaculation. Strategies: drug holiday (with short t½, NOT Fluoxetine), switch to Bupropion / Mirtazapine / Vilazodone / Vortioxetine, add Bupropion / Cyproheptadine / Sildenafil.
sexual_dysfunction_SSRI.hebrew_explanation: Dysfunction מיני מ-SSRI — 30-70%. ↓libido, anorgasmia, ejaculation מאוחר. אסטרטגיות: drug holiday (לא Fluoxetine), מעבר ל-Bupropion/Mirtazapine/Vilazodone/Vortioxetine, הוספת Bupropion/Cyproheptadine/Sildenafil.

antichol_toxidrome_emergency.category: Anticholinergic syndrome — clinical emergency (see Wonderland scene)
antichol_toxidrome_emergency.symbol: All Wonderland characters in mania — already covered in anticholinergic_toxidrome (batch 1C)
antichol_toxidrome_emergency.function_depiction: TCA overdose, antihistamine overdose, scopolamine. Tx: Physostigmine (cholinesterase inhibitor), supportive.
antichol_toxidrome_emergency.hebrew_explanation: תסמונת אנטיכולינרגית — מצב חירום. ראה WONDERLAND_TEAPARTY לסצנה מלאה. אובר-דוז של TCA/אנטיהיסטמין/Scopolamine. טיפול: Physostigmine + תומך.

DSM_neurodevelopmental.category: Neurodevelopmental Disorders — establishing scene (Special-Ed Classroom) — 6 ND families
DSM_neurodevelopmental.symbol: SPECIAL-ED CLASSROOM — a brightly-colored kindergarten room with 6 distinct corners, each showing a child characteristic of one ND disorder family. ASD CORNER: child sits cross-legged silently lining up toy trains in a perfectly straight row, wears large noise-cancelling headphones, eyes averted. ADHD CORNER: child bouncing on a chair surrounded by scattered toys, motion-lines and 'POW!' 'WHIZ!' speech bubbles, multiple half-finished activities. INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY (IDD) CORNER: child works slowly on a 5-piece beginner puzzle with a patient teacher's helping hand visible behind. SPECIFIC LEARNING DISORDER (SLD) CORNER: child looks confused at letters that visually swap and float ('b/d/p/q' rotating chaotically), placards mixing up reading order. COMMUNICATION DISORDER CORNER: child with sealed lips and an empty speech bubble OR with the speech bubble shown broken into stuttering fragments. TIC DISORDERS CORNER: child surrounded by comic-style action bubbles popping around their head — 'BLINK!' 'SHRUG!' 'AH!' 'TWITCH!'. At the center of the classroom: a teacher pointing at a tree-branch chart titled 'Neurodevelopmental Disorders' with 6 branches.
DSM_neurodevelopmental.mnemonic_link: Each corner = a specific ND disorder family with its hallmark visual. Same children reappear individually as the symbol of their disorder in per-disorder scenes.
DSM_neurodevelopmental.function_depiction: DSM Chapter 1 Neurodevelopmental Disorders all begin in early childhood and impair daily functioning. The 6 families: Intellectual Developmental Disorder (IDD) including Global Developmental Delay, Communication Disorders (language, speech-sound, childhood-onset fluency/stuttering, social-pragmatic), Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD), Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD), Specific Learning Disorder (SLD — reading/written-expression/math), Motor Disorders (Developmental Coordination, Stereotypic Movement, Tic incl. Tourette's).
DSM_neurodevelopmental.hebrew_explanation: כיתת-גן-מיוחדת — 6 פינות מובחנות לפי הפרעות נוירו-התפתחותיות. פינת ASD: ילד מסדר רכבות בקו ישר, אוזניות. פינת ADHD: ילד קופץ על כיסא, פיזור-דעת ובועות 'POW!'. פינת ID: ילד עם פאזל של 5 חלקים, סיוע מורה. פינת SLD: ילד מבולבל באותיות שמתחלפות ('b/d/p/q'). פינת Communication: ילד עם בועה ריקה / בועה מקוטעת (גמגום). פינת Tic: ילד מוקף בועות 'BLINK!' 'SHRUG!' 'AH!'. במרכז: מורה עם תרשים-עץ ND.

asd.category: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental
asd.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — ASD corner (standalone scene possible)
asd.symbol: ASD's TRAIN WORKSHOP — a child sits cross-legged on the floor of a quiet workshop, surrounded by toy trains arranged in a perfectly straight line by color and number (TRAIN #1, TRAIN #2, TRAIN #3...). The child wears oversized noise-cancelling headphones (sensory hyperreactivity) and a comfortable hoodie with the sleeves cut off (sensory hyporeactivity to texture). Their eyes look DOWNWARD or sideways, never at the camera or the visitor at the door (lack of eye contact). When a parent calls 'Sam!' from the doorway, the child does not respond or turn (social-emotional reciprocity deficit). On the wall: a chart listing the names and numbers of all 247 train models from memory (highly restricted, fixated interest). A blanket is taped over a window (light sensitivity). Labels stick to ordinary objects ('CUP', 'PEN', 'BOOK'). A self-stim toy (spinning fidget) hangs in the corner. The child rocks gently back and forth (stereotyped repetitive movement). When their schedule is changed unexpectedly, a small thought-bubble shows a melt-down: '!!!CHANGE!!!' (insistence on sameness).
asd.mnemonic_link: ASD = 'AUTO-mate' — child performs SAME routines automatically, mechanically. Train-lineup + noise-cancelling headphones + no eye contact + 'CHANGE = meltdown' = pathognomonic.
asd.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Criteria: A. Persistent deficits in SOCIAL COMMUNICATION and SOCIAL INTERACTION (ALL 3 required): (1) social-emotional reciprocity, (2) nonverbal communicative behaviors, (3) developing/maintaining relationships. B. RESTRICTED REPETITIVE PATTERNS of behavior/interests/activities (≥2 of 4): (1) stereotyped repetitive motor/speech/object use, (2) insistence on sameness, inflexible routines, (3) highly restricted fixated interests, (4) hyper- or hyporeactivity to sensory input. C. Symptoms in early developmental period (may not be fully manifest until demands exceed capacity). D. Cause significant impairment. E. Not better explained by IDD (though may co-occur). SEVERITY by support needed: Level 1 (requiring support), Level 2 (substantial), Level 3 (very substantial). Epidemiology: ~1-2% prevalence; M:F ~4:1 (under-diagnosed in girls who 'mask').
asd.hebrew_explanation: ASD — ילד בסדנת רכבות מסדר רכבות במספרים בקו ישר. אוזניות אנטי-רעש (סנסורי), פטיש מבט כלפי מטה (אין eye contact), לא מגיב לקריאת ההורה (חוסר reciprocity חברתי). תרשים עם 247 דגמי-רכבת מהזיכרון (תחום עניין מקובע). שמיכה על החלון (רגישות לאור). תוויות על חפצים. צעצוע מסתובב (self-stim). שינוי לוז = התקף (insistence on sameness). קריטריונים: A) ליקויים בתקשורת ואינטראקציה חברתית (כל 3); B) תבניות חוזרות מקובעות (≥2 מ-4 — תנועות סטריאוטיפיות, סדר, תחומי עניין, רגישות סנסורית); C) התחלה מוקדמת; D) ליקוי משמעותי; E) לא מוסבר בעיקר ע"י IDD. רמות 1-3 לפי תמיכה. שכיחות ~1-2%, גברים:נשים ~4:1.

adhd.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — ADHD corner (standalone scene possible)
adhd.symbol: ADHD's WHIRLWIND CLASSROOM — a child literally floats a few inches above their chair (hyperactive), legs in mid-kick, hair flying. Their desk is total chaos: pencils, papers, half-finished projects, dropped erasers, three different books open at once. THREE separate speech bubbles burst from their mouth simultaneously: 'Hey! Did you see — wait, what was I — OH! Look! — sorry — what?'. A clock shows they've changed activities 12 TIMES in one hour. Comic action-bubbles 'POW!' 'WHIZ!' 'ZIP!' surround them. A trail of dropped items winds across the floor behind them. A backpack hangs upside-down with contents spilling. The teacher in background looks exhausted, holding their head. BUT — importantly — the child is also handing a flower to another child while spinning (warmth/impulsivity, often misunderstood as 'bad'). Two scenes embedded: (a) at school + (b) at home — same chaos, demonstrating 'symptoms in 2+ settings'. A calendar showing the child has had these symptoms since age 5 (before age 12 cutoff).
adhd.mnemonic_link: ADHD = literally CAN'T SIT STILL + CAN'T STAY ON TASK. Floating above chair + chaos-trail + multiple speech bubbles + clock showing 12 activity-switches = pathognomonic. Same chaos in 2 settings (school + home) = required for diagnosis.
adhd.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Criteria: A. ≥6 of 9 INATTENTION symptoms (≥5 for adults age 17+) for ≥6 months: careless mistakes, can't sustain attention, doesn't listen, doesn't follow through, can't organize, avoids sustained mental effort, loses things, easily distracted, forgetful. AND/OR ≥6 of 9 HYPERACTIVITY-IMPULSIVITY: fidgets, leaves seat, runs/climbs inappropriately, can't engage quietly, 'on the go', talks excessively, blurts answers, can't wait turn, interrupts. B. Several symptoms before age 12. C. Symptoms in ≥2 settings. D. Clear impairment. E. Not better explained by another disorder. THREE PRESENTATIONS: Combined / Predominantly Inattentive / Predominantly Hyperactive-Impulsive. Prevalence: 5-7% children, 2.5% adults. M:F ~2:1 (girls more often inattentive presentation, under-diagnosed).
adhd.hebrew_explanation: ADHD — ילד מרחף מעל הכיסא (היפראקטיביות), שולחן כאוטי, 3 בועות-דיבור בו-זמנית. שעון מראה 12 החלפות פעילות בשעה. POW! WHIZ! ZIP! מסביב. שוביל פריטים שנפלו. גם נותן פרח לילד אחר תוך ספין (אימפולסיביות חמה). 2 סצנות: בית-ספר + בית (לתנאי 2 הסביבות). לוח-שנה: מאז גיל 5 (לפני 12). קריטריונים: A) ≥6 מ-9 inattention או ≥6 מ-9 hyperactivity-impulsivity ל-≥6 חודשים; B) לפני גיל 12; C) ב-2+ סביבות; D) ליקוי ברור; E) לא מוסבר אחרת. 3 הצגות: Combined / Inattentive / Hyperactive-Impulsive. שכיחות: 5-7% ילדים, 2.5% מבוגרים. M:F ~2:1 (בנות לרוב inattentive, פחות מאובחנות).

idd.category: Intellectual Developmental Disorder (IDD) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental
idd.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — IDD corner (standalone scene possible)
idd.symbol: IDD's SUPPORT ROOM — a school-age child sits at a low table working slowly and carefully on a 5-piece large-piece beginner PUZZLE. A patient adult assistant's hand is visible from behind, gently guiding (collaborative support — adaptive scaffolding). The walls are covered with a VISUAL SCHEDULE — photographs (not just text) showing each daily task in order: brush teeth → eat breakfast → put on shoes → school. Adaptive aids are everywhere: a spoon with a chunky grip handle, picture-menu for choosing food, large-button toys, simple labels. A growth chart on the wall shows the child IS growing physically, but a mental-age curve runs lower. The room is warm and supportive — a family tree poster shows multiple family members involved in raising the child. The child smiles proudly when completing each puzzle piece. A doctor's note pinned to the wall: 'Adaptive functioning is the focus — not IQ alone'. Severity badges (Mild / Moderate / Severe / Profound) hang above the child but pinned at 'Mild' for this scene.
idd.mnemonic_link: IDD = INTELLECTUAL + DEVELOPMENTAL + DEFICIT. Severity by ADAPTIVE function (not just IQ). 5-piece puzzle + visual schedule + adaptive aids + assistant's helping hand = pathognomonic. Previous name 'Mental Retardation' is outdated.
idd.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Criteria (ALL 3 required): A. Deficits in INTELLECTUAL functions (reasoning, problem-solving, planning, abstract thinking, judgment, academic learning, learning from experience), confirmed by clinical assessment AND individualized standardized intelligence testing (IQ ~<70). B. Deficits in ADAPTIVE FUNCTIONING resulting in failure to meet developmental and sociocultural standards for personal independence and social responsibility (across conceptual, social, practical domains). C. Onset during the developmental period (before age 22). SEVERITY by ADAPTIVE FUNCTIONING: Mild (~85%) / Moderate (~10%) / Severe (~3-4%) / Profound (~1-2%). Etiology: genetic (Down syndrome, Fragile X), prenatal (alcohol, infection), perinatal (hypoxia), postnatal (TBI, infection). Global Developmental Delay (GDD) = pre-age-5 provisional diagnosis when severity not yet established.
idd.hebrew_explanation: IDD (לשעבר 'פיגור שכלי') — ילד בחדר תמיכה עובד על פאזל 5 חלקים גדולים, יד-מבוגר עוזרת מלמעלה. לוח-שנה ויזואלי עם תמונות לכל מטלה (לא רק טקסט). אביזרי הסתגלות: כפית-עם-אחיזה, תפריט-תמונות, צעצועים פשוטים. גרף-גדילה: צומח פיזית אבל פיגור שכלי. תרשים-משפחה: רבים מעורבים. רושמים: 'תפקוד אדפטיבי הוא המוקד, לא רק IQ'. קריטריונים (כל 3): A) ליקויים בתפקוד שכלי (IQ~<70); B) ליקויים בתפקוד אדפטיבי (קונספטואלי/חברתי/פרקטי); C) הופעה לפני גיל 22. רמות לפי תפקוד אדפטיבי: קל ~85% / בינוני ~10% / חמור ~3-4% / עמוק ~1-2%. אטיולוגיה: גנטיקה (Down, Fragile X), טרום-לידתי (אלכוהול, זיהום), פרי-נטלי (היפוקסיה), פוסט-נטלי (TBI, זיהום). GDD = אבחנה זמנית לפני גיל 5.

sld.category: Specific Learning Disorder (SLD) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental
sld.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — SLD corner (standalone scene possible)
sld.symbol: SLD's MOVING LETTERS — a school-age child sits at a classroom desk with a textbook open. The letters and numbers on the page are LITERALLY moving and rotating in front of their eyes: 'b' rotates into 'd', 'p' flips into 'q', '6' inverts into '9', words appear scrambled ('REID' instead of 'RIDE'). The child stares with deep confusion, brow furrowed. Their pencil hovers over the page, frozen. A math problem on the blackboard reads '7 × 6 = ?' — the child's notebook shows random number attempts crossed out. CRITICAL DETAIL — on the same desk: a beautifully built MODEL ROCKET (the child's own work) with detailed accurate diagrams, showing intelligence is normal in OTHER domains. A clock shows they've been stuck on this page for 30 minutes while classmates have moved on. The teacher with a learning-specialist badge offers structured-literacy support. A specifier sign hangs: 'with impairment in reading' (dyslexia) — alternatives 'in math' (dyscalculia), 'in writing' (dysgraphia).
sld.mnemonic_link: SLD = SPECIFIC Learning Disorder — academic skill below age expectation despite NORMAL intelligence elsewhere. Moving letters + scrambled words + beautifully built rocket on the same desk = pathognomonic. Differs from IDD: SLD has NORMAL IQ except in one domain.
sld.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Criteria: A. Difficulties learning and using academic skills, ≥1 of 6 symptoms persisting ≥6 months despite intervention: (1) inaccurate or slow word reading (DYSLEXIA), (2) difficulty understanding meaning of what is read, (3) difficulties with spelling, (4) difficulties with written expression, (5) difficulties mastering number sense, facts, calculations (DYSCALCULIA), (6) difficulties with mathematical reasoning. B. Affected academic skills SUBSTANTIALLY and QUANTIFIABLY below age expectations, causing significant impairment (best confirmed by individually administered standardized achievement measures). C. Onset during school years (may not fully manifest until demands exceed limited capacity). D. NOT better explained by IDD, sensory impairments, mental/neurological disorders, language disorder, psychosocial adversity, lack of education. SPECIFIERS: with impairment in reading / written expression / mathematics. Severity: Mild / Moderate / Severe.
sld.hebrew_explanation: SLD — ילד בכיתה, האותיות זזות ומסתובבות: 'b'→'d', 'p'→'q', '6'→'9'. מילים מבולגנות (REID במקום RIDE). תקוע 30 דקות בעוד הכיתה התקדמה. **קריטי**: על אותו שולחן — דגם רקטה יפהפה שבנה לבד = אינטליגנציה תקינה בתחומים אחרים. הבדל מ-IDD: SLD = IQ תקין רק בתחום אחד פגוע. קריטריונים: A) קושי באקדמיה ≥6 חודשים למרות התערבות, ≥1 מ-6 — קריאה (דיסלקסיה), הבנת הנקרא, איות, כתיבה, חשבון (דיסקלקוליה), חשיבה מתמטית; B) הישגים מתחת לציפיות לפי גיל באופן מדיד; C) הופעה בשנות בית-ספר; D) לא מוסבר ע"י IDD/חושים/הפרעה אחרת/חוסר חינוך. ספציפיירס: קריאה / כתיבה / מתמטיקה. חומרה: קל / בינוני / חמור.
