communication_disorders.category: Communication Disorders — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental (Language, Speech Sound, Stuttering, Social-Pragmatic)
communication_disorders.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — Communication corner (standalone scene possible)
communication_disorders.symbol: SPEECH THERAPY ROOM — a colorful pediatric speech-therapy room with 4 vignettes showing the 4 communication disorder subtypes. CHILD 1 — LANGUAGE DISORDER: child at a table, struggling to find words; a thought bubble shows pictures of common objects (dog, cup, ball) but the SPEECH BUBBLE is empty or shows wrong-words (says 'cat' for 'dog'). Difficulty with vocabulary, sentence structure. CHILD 2 — SPEECH SOUND DISORDER: child says 'wabbit' for 'rabbit', 'fum' for 'thumb' — speech bubble shows the WORDS WITH WRONG SOUNDS articulated. The speech therapist holds a small mirror in front of the child's mouth to show tongue position. CHILD 3 — STUTTERING (Childhood-Onset Fluency Disorder): child says 'M-m-m-mommy I w-w-w-want' — speech bubble is BROKEN/FRAGMENTED with the same syllable repeated. A frustration expression on face. The therapist demonstrates a hand-tapping rhythm technique. CHILD 4 — SOCIAL (PRAGMATIC) COMMUNICATION DISORDER: child at a school table NOT taking turns in conversation, interrupting, missing nonverbal cues from peers. A poster of social rules on the wall ('TAKE TURNS', 'EYE CONTACT', 'WAIT YOUR TURN') with red X-marks where the child has missed. CRITICAL: this child has normal grammar/vocabulary but fails at SOCIAL USE.
communication_disorders.mnemonic_link: Communication Disorders = LANGUAGE + SPEECH-SOUND + STUTTER + SOCIAL-PRAGMATIC. 4 children in one room with 4 different speech-bubble pathologies = pathognomonic. Social-pragmatic differs from ASD: NO restricted/repetitive behaviors.
communication_disorders.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Communication Disorders include: (1) LANGUAGE DISORDER — persistent difficulties acquiring/using language across modalities (spoken, written, sign), with reduced vocabulary, limited sentence structure, impaired discourse. (2) SPEECH SOUND DISORDER — persistent difficulty with speech sound production interfering with intelligibility. (3) CHILDHOOD-ONSET FLUENCY DISORDER (STUTTERING) — disturbances in normal fluency: sound/syllable repetitions, sound prolongations, broken words, audible/silent blocking, circumlocutions, words produced with excess physical tension. (4) SOCIAL (PRAGMATIC) COMMUNICATION DISORDER — persistent difficulties in social use of verbal and nonverbal communication NOT due to autism (no restricted/repetitive behaviors required). Differential: All require onset in early development and exclusion of motor/hearing/other neurological causes.
communication_disorders.hebrew_explanation: חדר ריפוי בדיבור — 4 ילדים, 4 תת-סוגים. ילד 1 (Language Disorder): מתקשה למצוא מילים, בועה ריקה / מילים שגויות (cat במקום dog). ילד 2 (Speech Sound): 'wabbit' במקום 'rabbit'. מטפל עם מראה למפיק לשון. ילד 3 (Stuttering): 'מ-מ-מ-מאמא' — בועה מקוטעת חוזרת על הברה. ילד 4 (Social-Pragmatic): מקטיע בשיחה, לא ממתין לתור — שונה מ-ASD: ללא תבניות חוזרות/מקובעות. קריטריונים DSM-5-TR: (1) Language Disorder — קושי באוצר מילים/מבנה משפט/שיח; (2) Speech Sound — קושי בהפקת צלילים; (3) Stuttering — חזרות/הארכות/חסימות; (4) Social-Pragmatic — קושי בשימוש חברתי בתקשורת, ללא restricted/repetitive (מבדיל מ-ASD). כל אחת דורשת התחלה מוקדמת + שלילת סיבה מוטורית/שמיעתית/נוירולוגית.

tic_disorders.category: Tic Disorders (incl. Tourette's) — DSM Ch.1 Neurodevelopmental Motor Disorders
tic_disorders.scene: Special-Ed Classroom — Tic corner (standalone scene possible)
tic_disorders.symbol: TIC-LAND — a school-age child stands in the middle of their bedroom surrounded by sudden POP-UP comic-style action bubbles that burst around them involuntarily: 'BLINK!' (eye tic), 'SHRUG!' (shoulder tic), 'AH!' (vocal tic), 'TWITCH!' (neck tic), 'PFFT!' (lip pucker), 'WOOP!' (vocal). The child's body is mid-motion in multiple ways simultaneously — eye blink, shoulder shrug, neck jerk. A thermometer labeled 'PREMONITORY URGE' is positioned beside the child at a HIGH level just BEFORE each tic erupts (premonitory urge is hallmark). On a wall calendar: red marks showing the tics have been present for >1 YEAR (Tourette criterion). A timeline shows onset BEFORE age 18. The child's face shows mild embarrassment — aware of the tics but unable to fully suppress them. A speech therapist note: 'tics WAX AND WANE — better some weeks, worse others'. Pinned to wall: a chart 'Tourette = motor + vocal tics, both, for >1 year' vs 'Persistent motor OR vocal (one type only)' vs 'Provisional (<1 year)'.
tic_disorders.mnemonic_link: TIC = sudden, recurrent, NONRHYTHMIC motor or vocal pop-up. POP-UP bubbles 'BLINK! SHRUG! AH!' + premonitory urge thermometer + 1-year calendar = pathognomonic. Tourette REQUIRES both motor AND vocal tics.
tic_disorders.function_depiction: DSM-5-TR Tic Disorders: (1) TOURETTE'S DISORDER — MULTIPLE motor tics AND ≥1 vocal tic, present for >1 year, onset before age 18, not due to substance/medical. (2) PERSISTENT (CHRONIC) MOTOR OR VOCAL TIC DISORDER — single OR multiple motor OR vocal tics (NOT both), >1 year. (3) PROVISIONAL TIC DISORDER — tics present <1 year. Tics defined as: sudden, rapid, recurrent, nonrhythmic motor movements or vocalizations. PREMONITORY URGE often present (relievable by performing tic). Tics WAX AND WANE. Often comorbid with ADHD (~50%) and OCD (~30%). Treatment: behavioral (CBIT — Comprehensive Behavioral Intervention for Tics is first-line), α2-agonists (Clonidine, Guanfacine), antipsychotics (Haloperidol/Aripiprazole/Risperidone for severe), VMAT2 inhibitors (Tetrabenazine, Deutetrabenazine, Valbenazine). Coprolalia (involuntary obscenities) is RARE — only ~10% of Tourette's despite media portrayal.
tic_disorders.hebrew_explanation: TIC-LAND — ילד מוקף בועות-קומיקס פתאומיות: BLINK! SHRUG! AH! TWITCH! PFFT! WOOP!. גוף בתנועה מרובה. מד-חום 'דחף-מקדים' (premonitory urge) גבוה לפני כל טיק. לוח-שנה: >שנה. ציר-זמן: לפני גיל 18. הילד מעט נבוך — מודע אבל לא יכול לדכא לחלוטין. טיקים WAX AND WANE. אבחנות: Tourette = motor + vocal tics, שניהם, >שנה; Persistent (Chronic) = motor או vocal בלבד, >שנה; Provisional = <שנה. קומורבידיות גבוהה עם ADHD (~50%) ו-OCD (~30%). טיפול: CBIT (התנהגותי, קו-1), α2-agonists (Clonidine, Guanfacine), אנטיפסיכוטיים (Haloperidol, Aripiprazole, Risperidone), VMAT2 inhibitors. Coprolalia נדיר (~10% מ-Tourette, למרות הסטיגמה התקשורתית).

DSM_psychotic.category: Schizophrenia Spectrum and Other Psychotic Disorders
DSM_psychotic.symbol: A CRACKED MIRROR reflecting a distorted reality — voices visible as colored sound-waves
DSM_psychotic.function_depiction: Schizophrenia (>6 mo), Schizoaffective, Schizophreniform (1-6 mo), Brief Psychotic (<1 mo), Delusional, Catatonia. D2 blockade calms the mirror.
DSM_psychotic.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק פסיכוטי. סמל: מראה סדוקה משקפת מציאות מעוותת, קולות כגלים צבעוניים. סכיזופרניה (>6ח), סכיזואפקטיב, סכיזופרניפורם (1-6ח), Brief Psychotic (<1ח), הזיות, Catatonia. חסימת D2 מרגיעה את המראה.

DSM_bipolar.symbol: A SEE-SAW oscillating between a sun (mania) and a storm cloud (depression). North-pole iceberg in the background (Lithium connection).
DSM_bipolar.function_depiction: Bipolar I (mania), Bipolar II (hypomania + MDE), Cyclothymia. Mood stabilizers (Lithium battery, Lamb-trigger, etc.) balance the see-saw.
DSM_bipolar.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק דו-קוטבי. סמל: see-saw בין שמש (מאניה) לענן סוער (דיכאון), קרחון קוטב צפוני ברקע. ביפולר I, II, ציקלוטימיה. סוללת Li + 'lamb-trigger' מאזנים.

DSM_depressive.symbol: A GRAY RAIN CLOUD over a slumped figure — the SERT postal carrier piles up undelivered serotonin packages
DSM_depressive.function_depiction: MDD (≥2wk), PDD (≥2y), DMDD (children <18 with chronic irritability), PMDD. SIGECAPS mnemonic for symptoms.
DSM_depressive.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק דיכאוני. סמל: ענן גשם אפור מעל דמות שמוטה, ה-SERT דוור צובר חבילות סרוטונין שלא נמסרו. MDD (≥2ש), PDD (≥2שנה), DMDD (ילדים), PMDD. SIGECAPS.

DSM_anxiety.symbol: A FRIGHTENED RABBIT (from BUS_LINE_1A scene) multiplied — different rabbits for different anxieties
DSM_anxiety.function_depiction: Separation Anxiety, Selective Mutism, Specific Phobia, Social Anxiety, Panic, Agoraphobia, GAD. Buspirone bus + SSRI/SNRI from elsewhere.
DSM_anxiety.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק חרדה. סמל: שפן רועד (מתחנת אוטובוס 1A) מוכפל. Separation Anxiety, Selective Mutism, Phobia, Social Anxiety, Panic, Agoraphobia, GAD. אוטובוס Buspirone + SSRI/SNRI.

DSM_OCD_related.symbol: Hands SCRUBBING IN A LOOP — water spiraling endlessly, with a tally counter clicking
DSM_OCD_related.function_depiction: OCD, BDD, Hoarding, Trichotillomania, Excoriation. High-dose SSRI (Fluvoxamine, Sertraline) + Clomipramine (TCA-SSRI hybrid). ERP therapy gold standard.
DSM_OCD_related.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק OCD. סמל: ידיים שוטפות בלולאה, מים מסתחררים אינסופית, מונה. OCD, BDD, Hoarding, Trichotillomania, Excoriation. SSRI במינון גבוה (Fluvoxamine, Sertraline) + Clomipramine. ERP זהב.

DSM_trauma_stressor.symbol: A BROKEN PHOTO frame with a shattered timeline behind it — flashback arrows pointing backward in time
DSM_trauma_stressor.function_depiction: PTSD, Acute Stress, Adjustment, RAD, DSED. Prazosin's praise-soldier helps with nightmares. SSRIs first-line. Trauma-focused CBT, EMDR.
DSM_trauma_stressor.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק טראומה. סמל: מסגרת תמונה שבורה עם זמן מתופרר, חצי flashback אחורה. PTSD, Acute Stress, Adjustment, RAD, DSED. Prazosin לסיוטים. SSRI קו ראשון. TF-CBT, EMDR.

DSM_dissociative.symbol: A FRAGMENTED MIRROR showing multiple selves, or a watch with the present erased
DSM_dissociative.function_depiction: DID, Depersonalization/Derealization, Dissociative Amnesia. Trauma-focused psychotherapy primary.
DSM_dissociative.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק דיסוציאטיבי. סמל: מראה מקוטעת עם מספר עצמים, שעון עם הווה מחוק. DID, Depersonalization/Derealization, אמנזיה דיסוציאטיבית. פסיכותרפיה ממוקדת-טראומה.

DSM_somatic.symbol: A patient with EXAGGERATED body markings (pain arrows) but doctor's stethoscope finds nothing
DSM_somatic.function_depiction: SSD, Illness Anxiety, Conversion, Factitious. CBT primary. Antidepressants for comorbid mood.
DSM_somatic.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק סומטי. סמל: מטופל עם סימני גוף מודגשים אבל הסטטוסקופ של הרופא לא מוצא דבר. SSD, Illness Anxiety, Conversion, Factitious. CBT עיקרי.

DSM_feeding_eating.symbol: Empty plate next to a measuring tape (Anorexia) + binge plate (Bulimia/BED) + restricted food list (ARFID)
DSM_feeding_eating.function_depiction: AN, BN, BED, ARFID, Pica, Rumination. AN: highest mortality of psych disorders. SSRIs (Fluoxetine for BN), Topiramate for BED. Family-based therapy in adolescent AN.
DSM_feeding_eating.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק אכילה. סמל: צלחת ריקה ליד סרט מדידה (Anorexia) + צלחת binge (BN, BED) + רשימה מגבילה (ARFID). AN: התמותה הגבוהה ביותר. Fluoxetine ל-BN. Topiramate ל-BED. FBT לנער/ה.

DSM_elimination.symbol: A toilet with a question mark — Enuresis (wet bed) or Encopresis (soiled clothes)
DSM_elimination.function_depiction: Enuresis: behavioral (bell-and-pad), Desmopressin (V2 ADH agonist), low-dose Imipramine. Encopresis: pediatrics workup first.
DSM_elimination.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק הפרשה. אסלה עם סימן שאלה — Enuresis (ספיגה לילית), Encopresis. Enuresis: bell-and-pad, Desmopressin, Imipramine מינון נמוך. Encopresis: בירור פדיאטרי קודם.

DSM_sleep_wake.symbol: A MOON + CLOCK + tired patient with sheep refusing to be counted — different sub-scenes for each
DSM_sleep_wake.function_depiction: Insomnia, Hypersomnolence, Narcolepsy (Pitolisant alarm clock at H3), Breathing-related, Circadian, Parasomnias, RLS. CBT-I first-line for chronic insomnia.
DSM_sleep_wake.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק שינה. ירח + שעון + מטופל עייף. Insomnia, Hypersomnolence, Narcolepsy (Pitolisant), Breathing-related, Circadian, Parasomnias, RLS. CBT-I קו ראשון ל-insomnia כרוני.

DSM_sexual_dysfunction.symbol: A 'PAUSED' relationship icon — different specifics for different dysfunctions
DSM_sexual_dysfunction.function_depiction: Delayed Ejaculation, ED, Female Orgasmic, FSIAD, Genito-Pelvic Pain, Male Hypoactive Desire, Premature Ejaculation, Substance-induced. SSRI sexual side effects are major substance-induced cause.
DSM_sexual_dysfunction.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק תפקודים מיניים. סמל: סמל זוגיות 'מושהה'. Delayed Ejaculation, ED, Female Orgasmic, FSIAD, Genito-Pelvic Pain, Hypoactive Desire, Premature Ejaculation, Substance-induced. SSRI גורם חשוב.

DSM_gender_dysphoria.symbol: A figure with two different reflections in a mirror — assigned vs. experienced
DSM_gender_dysphoria.function_depiction: Supportive care, gender-affirming therapy. Psychiatric comorbidities (depression, anxiety) treated standardly.
DSM_gender_dysphoria.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק דיספוריה מגדרית. סמל: דמות עם שתי השתקפויות שונות במראה — מוקצה מול חוויה. טיפול תומך, gender-affirming care.

DSM_disruptive_impulse.symbol: An EXPLOSION sign with broken rules — ODD (defiant child), Conduct (escalation), IED (anger explosion)
DSM_disruptive_impulse.function_depiction: ODD, CD, IED, Kleptomania, Pyromania, Antisocial PD. Behavioral therapy + parent management. Sometimes Risperidone for severe aggression.
DSM_disruptive_impulse.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק impulsive. סמל: סימן פיצוץ עם חוקים שבורים. ODD (התנגדות), CD (הסלמה), IED (כעס פתאומי), Kleptomania, Pyromania, Antisocial PD. טיפול: behavioral + parent management. לפעמים Risperidone לתוקפנות חמורה.

DSM_substance_addictive.symbol: A bottle + syringe + cigarette + dice — addictive substances + behaviors converging on the DOPA-MINE CASINO
DSM_substance_addictive.mnemonic_link: All addictions converge on mesolimbic reward.
DSM_substance_addictive.function_depiction: Alcohol (Naltrexone, Acamprosate, Disulfiram), Opioid (Methadone, Buprenorphine), Tobacco (Varenicline, NRT, Bupropion), Stimulants (limited pharm), Cannabis, Gambling, etc.
DSM_substance_addictive.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק חומרים. סמל: בקבוק + מזרק + סיגריה + קוביות — כולם מתכנסים לקזינו DOPA-MINE. Alcohol (Naltrexone, Acamprosate, Disulfiram), Opioid (Methadone, Buprenorphine), Tobacco (Varenicline, NRT, Bupropion), Stimulants, Cannabis, Gambling.

DSM_neurocognitive.function_depiction: Delirium remains relevant (acute confusion in any age). Memorize: hyperactive/hypoactive/mixed; reversible causes; antipsychotic for severe agitation only (Haloperidol or atypical low-dose).
DSM_neurocognitive.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק נוירו-קוגניטיבי — מדולג ע"פ בקשה (גריאטרי). Delirium עדיין רלוונטי (בלבול אקוטי): hyperactive/hypoactive/mixed; חיפוש סיבה הפיכה; אנטיפסיכוטי במינון נמוך רק להתסערות חמורה.

DSM_personality_disorders.category: Personality Disorders — establishing scene (Personality Inn) — 10 specific PDs + General Criteria
DSM_personality_disorders.symbol: PERSONALITY INN — a theatrical 3-room tavern at night. Cluster A room (dimly-lit, weird-eccentric, blue-purple shadows): PARANOID guest peers from behind a menu with dark sunglasses, suspicious of everyone; SCHIZOID guest sits alone in a cold corner, no expression, eats by himself; SCHIZOTYPAL guest wears a wizard hat reading tarot cards over dinner, talks to invisible spirits. Cluster B room (red-gold, dramatic, candlelit): ANTISOCIAL in a leather coat steals from the register without remorse; BORDERLINE has two opposing faces (loving the waiter from the left side, hating the same waiter from the right side); NARCISSISTIC stares only into a hand-mirror admiring himself, ignoring others; HISTRIONIC stands ON the table performing a dramatic monologue with arms spread wide. Cluster C room (blue-gray, anxious, fluorescent): AVOIDANT hides behind a giant menu fearing rejection; DEPENDENT clings tightly to another guest, unable to choose food alone; OCPD lines up cutlery in perfect parallel rows so obsessively that they miss the meal itself. At the inn's entrance hall: a faceless MANNEQUIN statue with a sign 'GENERAL PD CRITERIA A-F' (see general_PD_criteria entry).
DSM_personality_disorders.mnemonic_link: Each character carries a primary visual hook for their PD pattern. Same characters reappear individually in per-PD scenes. 3 rooms = 3 clusters with thematic lighting (weird/dramatic/anxious).
DSM_personality_disorders.function_depiction: Cluster A (odd/eccentric): paranoid distrust, schizoid detachment, schizotypal magical thinking. Cluster B (dramatic/erratic): antisocial criminal disregard, borderline unstable relationships and self-image, narcissistic grandiosity, histrionic attention-seeking. Cluster C (anxious/fearful): avoidant social inhibition, dependent submission, OCPD rigid perfectionism. All require General PD Criteria A-F to diagnose.
DSM_personality_disorders.hebrew_explanation: פונדק-המסכות — תפאורה תיאטרלית עם 3 חדרים תמטיים ו-10 אורחים. Cluster A (מוזר, אפלולי כחול-סגול): פראנואיד עם משקפי-שמש מציץ; שיזואיד בודד וקר; שיזוטיפלי עם כובע-קוסם וקלפי-טארוט. Cluster B (דרמטי, אדום-זהב): אנטיסוציאלי גונב מהקופה; בורדרליין דו-פנים (אוהב+שונא); נרציסיסטי מסתכל במראה; היסטריוני עומד על השולחן. Cluster C (חרד, כחול-אפור): מתחמק חבוי בתפריט; תלותי נצמד; OCPD מסדר סכו"ם בקווים מושלמים. בכניסה: פסל-מנקין 'GENERAL PD CRITERIA A-F'.

general_PD_criteria.category: DSM-5-TR General Criteria for Personality Disorder (A through F)
general_PD_criteria.symbol: A museum-style gallery with six framed exhibits arranged in order A B C D E F, each visualizing one general PD criterion. At the gallery center: a FACELESS MANNEQUIN labeled 'PERSONALITY' (the empty form the criteria define). Exhibit A 'ALWAYS Pattern' — an eternal CLOCK with the same wave-pattern repeating endlessly on its face (enduring inner experience and behavior deviating from cultural expectations). Exhibit B 'BROAD Reach' — a COMPASS spreading arrows in all 360 degrees, each arrow touching a different life-domain (work, love, friendship, leisure) — pervasive across personal/social situations. Exhibit C 'CAUSES Distress' — a figure CHAINED by their own personality-strands, weeping (clinically significant distress or impairment). Exhibit D 'DECADES Stable' — a long CALENDAR-SCROLL stretching from an adolescent silhouette through to an adult, the same pattern unchanged on every page (stable, of long duration, traceable to adolescence/early adulthood). Exhibit E 'EXCLUDES Other' — a large X-sign over a list of other mental disorder names (Bipolar, MDD, Anxiety, Psychotic) — not better explained by another mental disorder. Exhibit F 'FREE of Substance' — a syringe and a pill bottle each with a circular Ø symbol over them (not attributable to substance/medical condition).
general_PD_criteria.mnemonic_link: A=Always (enduring pattern), B=Broad (pervasive), C=Causes distress, D=Decades stable, E=Excluding other mental, F=Free of substance. Six letters embedded as exhibit labels — each visual encodes the meaning of its letter.
general_PD_criteria.function_depiction: All six criteria (A through F) must be satisfied to diagnose any specific Personality Disorder. The specific cluster (A/B/C) and individual PD diagnoses cannot be applied without these general criteria being met first.
general_PD_criteria.hebrew_explanation: גלריית 'מרקר-קבוע' — 6 תערוכות ממוסגרות A עד F לקריטריונים הכלליים של הפרעת אישיות. במרכז: פסל-מנקין-פנים-ריקות = אישיות. A=Always (שעון נצחי עם תבנית חוזרת). B=Broad (מצפן 360° נוגע בכל תחומי חיים). C=Causes (אדם אזוק לאישיותו, בוכה). D=Decades (לוח-שנה: מתבגר → מבוגר, אותה תבנית). E=Excluding (X על רשימת אבחנות אחרות). F=Free (Ø על מזרק וכדורים). חייבים את כל 6 כדי לאבחן PD ספציפי.

paranoid_pd.scene: Personality Inn — Cluster A room (the weird-eccentric dim room)
paranoid_pd.symbol: PARANOID's HQ — a person sitting in a dim apartment that has been converted into a conspiracy bunker. Walls are covered floor-to-ceiling with red yarn connecting newspaper clippings, photographs of acquaintances marked with red circles and arrows. The person wears a tin-foil hat and dark sunglasses, peering through binoculars at the neighbor across the street. On the desk: a stack of letters labeled 'I read between the lines' (hidden meanings); a sign 'TRUST NO ONE — they're all in on it'; a photo of their spouse marked 'CHEATING?'. Pets, mail carriers, and even children outside are viewed as potential spies. The character never confides anything personal.
paranoid_pd.mnemonic_link: PARA-NOID = PAR-A-NOIA = 'beside reason'. Tin-foil hat + red-yarn conspiracy board = pathognomonic. Sunglasses + binoculars = surveillance mindset.
paranoid_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥4 of 7): (1) Suspects without basis that others are exploiting, harming, deceiving; (2) Preoccupied with unjustified doubts about loyalty of friends/associates; (3) Reluctant to confide for fear of malicious use; (4) Reads hidden demeaning/threatening meanings into benign remarks; (5) Persistently bears grudges; (6) Perceives attacks not apparent to others, quick to react angrily; (7) Recurrent unjustified suspicions of spouse/partner infidelity. Differential: not during a psychotic disorder; not paranoid schizophrenia (no hallucinations/delusions); not from substance/medical.
paranoid_pd.hebrew_explanation: PARANOID PD — דמות במרתף קונספירציה, כובע-נייר-כסף, משקפי-שמש, מציץ במשקפת. קירות מלאים בחוט-אדום ותמונות עם חיצים. חוסר אמון מתמיד ללא בסיס. קריטריונים (≥4 מ-7): חשד בניצול/פגיעה, ספקות בנאמנות חברים, אי-נכונות לחשוף, קריאת משמעויות נסתרות, נטירת טינה, תפיסת התקפות, חשד בבגידה זוגית. אבחנה-מבדלת: לא בזמן פסיכוזה; לא סכיזופרניה פרנואידית; לא מסם/רפואי.

schizoid_pd.symbol: SCHIZOID's ISLAND — a person sits alone on a tiny one-tree desert island in their own private cloud, perfectly content. A 'NO VISITORS' sign at the shore. The person reads a book with a flat blank expression — no joy, no sadness. A discarded party invitation floats unopened in the water nearby. In a thought-bubble: solo activities only (chess against self, solo computer use, watching the stars alone). When ferries pass with people waving, the character does not wave back or even look up. A small inset shows an attempted romantic encounter — the character looks at the suitor with complete indifference.
schizoid_pd.mnemonic_link: SCHIZ-OID = 'shy-zone' / personal zone of solitude (not psychotic, just truly content alone). Island + 'no visitors' sign + flat blank face = pathognomonic. CRITICAL: voluntary detachment, no desire for connection (contrast with Avoidant PD).
schizoid_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥4 of 7): (1) Neither desires nor enjoys close relationships, including family; (2) Almost always chooses solitary activities; (3) Little/no interest in sexual experiences; (4) Takes pleasure in few activities; (5) Lacks close friends or confidants other than first-degree relatives; (6) Appears indifferent to praise or criticism; (7) Emotional coldness, detachment, or flat affectivity. Differential: vs Avoidant PD (Avoidant WANTS connection but fears rejection; Schizoid does NOT want it); vs ASD (Schizoid lacks ASD's restricted interests/repetitive behaviors); not during psychotic disorder.
schizoid_pd.hebrew_explanation: SCHIZOID PD — דמות לבדה על אי-מדבר זעיר עם עץ אחד, שלט 'אסור אורחים', הזמנת-מסיבה צפה ללא פתיחה. פנים ריקות-מבע, אדישה מוחלטת. הבדל קריטי מ-Avoidant: השיזואיד **לא רוצה** קשרים, לא **פוחד** מהם. קריטריונים (≥4 מ-7): לא מעוניין/לא נהנה מקשרים קרובים; פעילויות בודדות; חוסר עניין מיני; הנאה מועטה; אין חברים קרובים; אדיש לשבח/ביקורת; קרירות רגשית/אפקט שטוח. אבחנה-מבדלת: לא Avoidant (שרוצה קשרים), לא ASD (ללא תחומי-עניין מוגבלים חוזרים), לא בזמן פסיכוזה.

schizotypal_pd.symbol: SCHIZOTYPAL's TEPEE — a person in a homemade wizard-robe sits cross-legged in a colorful tepee tent in their living room, reading tarot cards by candlelight. A lava lamp glows beside them. They wear mismatched layered clothing (shawl + boots + monocle). Around them: crystal balls, dream catchers, astrological charts on the walls, a half-finished spell-book. They mutter strange ideas: 'the TV anchor was speaking directly to me' (idea of reference), 'I can feel my grandmother's ghost present', 'I have telepathic powers but only on Tuesdays'. They believe these things SINCERELY but are not floridly psychotic. Speech is odd, vague, metaphorical. They have no close friends besides their cat 'Whiskerwitch'.
schizotypal_pd.mnemonic_link: SCHIZO-TYPAL = SCHIZO-TIPI (homemade tepee). 'Typal' sounds like 'tipi'. Magical thinking + odd appearance + odd speech but no actual psychosis = pathognomonic.
schizotypal_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥5 of 9): (1) Ideas of reference (excluding delusions of reference); (2) Odd beliefs / magical thinking influencing behavior (clairvoyance, telepathy, sixth sense); (3) Unusual perceptual experiences including bodily illusions; (4) Odd thinking and speech (vague, circumstantial, metaphorical, overelaborate); (5) Suspiciousness / paranoid ideation; (6) Inappropriate or constricted affect; (7) Behavior or appearance odd, eccentric, peculiar; (8) Lack of close friends or confidants other than first-degree relatives; (9) Excessive social anxiety not lessened with familiarity, tends to be paranoid. Genetically linked to schizophrenia spectrum.
schizotypal_pd.hebrew_explanation: SCHIZOTYPAL PD — דמות בגלימת קוסם בתוך טיפי ביתי, קלפי טארוט, כדור-בדולח, אסטרולוגיה. אמונות מאגיות (טלפתיה, רוחות), ideas of reference, דיבור משונה ועקיף. לא פסיכוטי בפועל. מקושר גנטית לספקטרום סכיזופרני. קריטריונים (≥5 מ-9): ideas of reference, אמונות מאגיות, חוויות תפיסה לא רגילות, חשיבה/דיבור משונה, חשדנות, אפקט מצומצם/לא הולם, מראה/התנהגות אקסצנטריים, אין חברים קרובים, חרדה חברתית מוגזמת שאינה פוחתת עם היכרות.

antisocial_pd.scene: Personality Inn — Cluster B room (red-gold dramatic)
antisocial_pd.symbol: ANTISOCIAL's HEIST — a person in a leather jacket and dark sunglasses is hot-wiring a stolen car in a back alley at night. Behind them on a wall: a 'WANTED' poster with their own face on it, which they ignore casually. A wallet on the ground next to a passed-out victim — the character takes the cash with no expression of remorse. A calendar on a brick wall shows their conduct-disorder rap sheet beginning at age 14 (vandalism, fighting, fire-setting, cruelty to animals). Their phone shows a series of lies they've told the police, an ex-partner, and a boss — all without flinching. A speech bubble: 'rules are for suckers'.
antisocial_pd.mnemonic_link: ANTI-SOCIAL = 'against society'. Leather jacket + 'WANTED' poster + no remorse for victim = pathognomonic. The age-15-onset conduct disorder rap sheet is REQUIRED (diagnosis is for age ≥18 with childhood CD).
antisocial_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (age ≥18 AND evidence of Conduct Disorder before age 15; pattern since age 15) — ≥3 of 7: (1) Failure to conform to social norms (repeated arrests); (2) Deceitfulness — repeated lying, conning for pleasure or profit; (3) Impulsivity / failure to plan ahead; (4) Irritability and aggressiveness — repeated fights/assaults; (5) Reckless disregard for safety of self or others; (6) Consistent irresponsibility (work, financial); (7) Lack of remorse — indifferent to or rationalizes hurting/mistreating/stealing from others. Higher prevalence in males; comorbid with substance use disorders and ADHD.
antisocial_pd.hebrew_explanation: ANTISOCIAL PD (ASPD) — דמות במעיל-עור מציתת מכונית גנובה בסמטה, פוסטר WANTED שלה על הקיר ללא תגובה רגשית, גוזלת ארנק מקורבן ללא חרטה. רשימת עברות מאז גיל 14. דיבור: 'חוקים לפרייארים'. אבחנה: גיל ≥18 + Conduct Disorder לפני 15. קריטריונים (≥3 מ-7): אי-ציות לחוק, שקרנות, אימפולסיביות, רוגז/אגרסיביות, חוסר אכפתיות מבטיחות, חוסר אחריות, חוסר חרטה. נפוצה יותר בגברים, קומורבידי עם הפרעות שימוש בחומרים ו-ADHD.

borderline_pd.symbol: BORDERLINE's CLIFF EDGE — a person stands exactly ON a literal red BORDER LINE painted on the floor, one foot on each side. They have TWO FACES: the left side beams loving adoration toward a friend, the right side blazes with rage toward the same friend (splitting). In their hand: a phone calling someone, eyes wide with TERROR they won't answer (fear of abandonment). Their other hand shows fresh razor marks (self-harm). The mirror behind them reflects FOUR different identities (who am I today?) — punk, scholar, hippie, executive — none feeling real (identity disturbance). The floor around them is cracked from emotional storms. A speech bubble: 'I HATE you / Don't leave me'. Behind: scattered impulsive purchases (shopping spree), an empty bottle (substance use), a one-night-stand silhouette.
borderline_pd.mnemonic_link: BORDER-LINE = always on the border, never stable. The two-faced split + abandonment terror + self-harm + 4 identities = the BPD pentad. 'I HATE you / Don't leave me' = the iconic BPD message.
borderline_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥5 of 9): (1) Frantic efforts to avoid real or imagined abandonment; (2) Pattern of unstable and intense interpersonal relationships alternating between idealization and devaluation (splitting); (3) Identity disturbance — markedly unstable self-image; (4) Impulsivity in ≥2 potentially self-damaging areas (spending, sex, substance, reckless driving, binge eating); (5) Recurrent suicidal behavior, gestures, threats, or self-mutilation; (6) Affective instability — marked mood reactivity (hours, not days); (7) Chronic feelings of emptiness; (8) Inappropriate intense anger or difficulty controlling anger; (9) Transient stress-related paranoid ideation or severe dissociative symptoms. Onset late adolescence/early adulthood; ~75% female. Treatment: DBT (Linehan) is gold standard; MBT (Bateman/Fonagy); medications adjunctive only (no FDA-approved drug for BPD itself).
borderline_pd.hebrew_explanation: BORDERLINE PD — דמות עומדת בדיוק על קו-גבול אדום, שתי פנים (אוהבת + זועמת לאותו חבר), טלפון ביד עם פחד-נטישה, חתכים על הזרוע, 4 בבואות במראה (זהות לא יציבה), משבוץ של רכישות אימפולסיביות/בקבוק/יחסי מין חולפים. סלוגן: 'אני שונאת אותך / אל תעזוב'. קריטריונים (≥5 מ-9): מאמצים נואשים נגד נטישה; קשרים לא יציבים (splitting); זהות מעורערת; אימפולסיביות ב-2+ תחומים; אובדנות/חתכים חוזרים; אי-יציבות רגשית (שעות); ריקנות כרונית; כעס לא הולם; פרנויה/dissociation בלחץ. גיל הופעה: סוף נעורים/בגרות צעירה; ~75% נשים. טיפול: DBT (Linehan) גוף-זהב; MBT (Bateman/Fonagy); תרופות רק אדג'ובנטיות (אין FDA-approved ל-BPD).

narcissistic_pd.symbol: NARCISSUS'S THRONE ROOM — a person in a golden crown stamped 'ME' sits on a throne in a marble palace lined with mirrors and self-portraits. They gaze adoringly into a giant hand-mirror that reflects them as a glowing god-king. Trophies, awards, and 'World's Greatest' plaques fill every shelf. Subjects/admirers crawl on the floor offering compliments — the king accepts them as their natural due. In the corner: a friend sits crying, completely ignored. The throne-room phone shows missed calls from people in need — 'why should I help?'. Outside the window: a Greek myth — Narcissus by the pond. A speech bubble: 'Of course they're jealous of me'.
narcissistic_pd.mnemonic_link: NARCISSUS = Greek youth who fell in love with own reflection. Crown 'ME' + mirror-throne + ignoring crying friend + entitled compliments = pathognomonic.
narcissistic_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥5 of 9): (1) Grandiose sense of self-importance (exaggerates achievements, expects recognition); (2) Preoccupied with fantasies of unlimited success, power, brilliance, beauty, or ideal love; (3) Believes 'special' and unique, can only be understood by other special/high-status people; (4) Requires excessive admiration; (5) Sense of entitlement; (6) Interpersonally exploitative; (7) Lacks empathy; (8) Often envious of others or believes others envy them; (9) Arrogant, haughty behaviors or attitudes. Two subtypes: GRANDIOSE (overt) and VULNERABLE (covert — secretly fragile, hypersensitive to criticism). High comorbidity with depression following narcissistic injury.
narcissistic_pd.hebrew_explanation: NARCISSISTIC PD — דמות בכתר זהב חרוט 'ME' יושבת על כס בארמון-מראות, נועצת מבט עצמי במראה ענקית המראה אותה כמלך-אל זוהר. גביעים ו'world's greatest' בכל פינה. מעריצים זוחלים מציעים מחמאות. חבר בוכה בפינה — מתעלמים. מצוטטת מיתולוגיה יוונית של נרקיסוס. קריטריונים (≥5 מ-9): גרנדיוזיות, פנטזיות הצלחה/יופי, אמונה ב'מיוחד' שמובן רק על-ידי אחרים מיוחדים, צורך בהערצה מוגזמת, תחושת זכאות, ניצול בין-אישי, חוסר אמפתיה, קנאה (גם של אחרים), התנשאות. 2 תתי-סוגים: גרנדיוזי (גלוי) ופגיע (סמוי, רגיש לביקורת). קומורבידיות גבוהה עם דיכאון לאחר 'פגיעה נרציסיסטית'.

histrionic_pd.symbol: HISTRIONIC's STAGE — a person stands center stage under a single dazzling SPOTLIGHT, arms thrown wide, throwing bouquets of flowers to themselves while an unseen audience cheers. They wear a flamboyant red sequined dress (or velvet suit), with theatrical makeup. They're crying dramatically — but watching themselves cry in a hand-mirror to check the effect. Costumes for FIVE different identities hang behind them (princess, pirate, doctor, ghost, gangster). A poster on the wall reads 'PLEASE LOOK AT ME' in glitter. They wave at a stranger across the room and CALL THEM by a pet name (over-intimate). Speech bubbles are theatrical and impressionistic: 'It was simply marvelous! Stunning! Out of this WORLD!' — no detail.
histrionic_pd.mnemonic_link: HIS-TRIONIC = HIS-tory + TRIO + iconic = THEATRICAL (Latin: histrio = actor). Spotlight + flamboyant outfit + dramatic crying-for-effect + 'please look at me' = pathognomonic. CRITICAL: shallow, attention-driven (contrast with BPD's depth of pain).
histrionic_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥5 of 8): (1) Uncomfortable when not the center of attention; (2) Inappropriately sexually seductive or provocative; (3) Rapidly shifting and shallow expression of emotions; (4) Uses physical appearance to draw attention; (5) Speech excessively impressionistic and lacking in detail; (6) Self-dramatization, theatricality, exaggerated expression of emotion; (7) Suggestible — easily influenced; (8) Considers relationships more intimate than they actually are. Differential: vs BPD (HPD is shallow attention-seeking; BPD has deep abandonment terror, self-harm, identity disturbance).
histrionic_pd.hebrew_explanation: HISTRIONIC PD — דמות במרכז הבמה תחת זרקור, זורקת לעצמה זרי-פרחים. שמלה אדומה זוהרת או חליפת קטיפה, איפור תיאטרלי. בוכה דרמטית אבל מסתכלת במראה לוודא את האפקט. 5 תלבושות שונות מאחור. שלט 'PLEASE LOOK AT ME' מנצנץ. דיבור תיאטרלי וכללי: 'נפלא! מהמם! אגדי!'. קריטריונים (≥5 מ-8): אי-נוחות שלא במרכז תשומת לב, פיתוי לא הולם, רגש משתנה רדוד, שימוש במראה למשיכת תשומת לב, דיבור רושמני וחסר פירוט, דרמטיזציה עצמית, סוגסטיביליות, חשיבה על מערכות יחסים כיותר אינטימיות ממה שהן. אבחנה-מבדלת מ-BPD: HPD רדוד; BPD = פחד נטישה עמוק + self-harm.

avoidant_pd.scene: Personality Inn — Cluster C room (blue-gray anxious)
avoidant_pd.symbol: AVOIDANT's PILLOW FORT — a person hides under a tall stack of pillows and blankets in their bedroom, only their wide-frightened eyes peer out. On the floor by the door: a party invitation slid in, which the person looks at LONGINGLY but trembles to act on (CRITICAL — they WANT to go but fear rejection). A telephone has rung 8 times and gone to voicemail. On a corkboard above the bed: 'social inept', 'they'll think I'm boring', 'better not even try'. A friend's photo is taped on the wall with a thought-bubble: 'maybe one day'. A clock shows that the person was supposed to be at a job interview an hour ago. Their journal is open — 'I should have said hello to the cashier today'.
avoidant_pd.mnemonic_link: AVOIDANT = visible avoidance of people. Pillow fort + longing look at party invite + 'I should have said hello' regret = pathognomonic. CRITICAL CONTRAST WITH SCHIZOID: Avoidant WANTS social connection but FEARS rejection; Schizoid does not want it at all.
avoidant_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥4 of 7): (1) Avoids occupational activities involving significant interpersonal contact, fearing criticism/rejection; (2) Unwilling to interact unless certain of being liked; (3) Restrained in intimate relationships fearing being shamed or ridiculed; (4) Preoccupied with being criticized or rejected in social situations; (5) Inhibited in new interpersonal situations due to feelings of inadequacy; (6) Views self as socially inept, personally unappealing, or inferior; (7) Reluctant to take personal risks for fear of embarrassment. Differential: vs Schizoid (Avoidant wants connection, Schizoid does not); vs Social Anxiety Disorder (AvPD is pervasive across life, more chronic).
avoidant_pd.hebrew_explanation: AVOIDANT PD — דמות מתחבאת תחת ערמת כריות, רק עיניים מבוהלות מציצות. הזמנת-מסיבה נשלפה מתחת לדלת — מסתכלת בכמיהה אבל רועדת. טלפון מצלצל 8 פעמים בלי מענה. לוח-מודעות: 'לא יוצלח חברתית', 'הם יחשבו שאני משעמם'. שעון מראה שהיא איחרה לראיון עבודה. הבדל קריטי מ-Schizoid: ה-Avoidant **רוצה** קשרים אבל **פוחד** מדחייה. קריטריונים (≥4 מ-7): נמנע ממקצועות בהם מגע חברתי, לא מוכן ליצור קשר אלא אם בטוח באהבה, מצומצם במערכות אינטימיות, עסוק בביקורת/דחייה, מעוכב במצבים חדשים, רואה את עצמו כחברתית-לא-מוצלח, נמנע מסיכונים מחשש למבוכה. אבחנה-מבדלת: שונה מ-Schizoid (רוצה קשרים); שונה מהפרעת חרדה חברתית (חוצה כל הזמן + כרוני).

dependent_pd.symbol: DEPENDENT's KOALA CLING — a grown adult (age 35-ish) clings to a friend's back like a koala bear, arms wrapped around the friend's shoulders, unable to stand on their own legs. The friend is trying to walk but is weighed down. On the friend's clothing: dozens of little post-it notes asking 'what should I wear today?', 'should I order the salad?', 'is this the right job?'. A speech bubble from the dependent character: 'whatever YOU think is best!' (about every decision). In the background, a previous partner is leaving through the door — and the dependent character is already on the phone DESPERATELY texting a new potential caregiver. The character cannot bear to disagree, even when asked their opinion (visible struggle: 'do you like THIS or THAT?').
dependent_pd.mnemonic_link: DE-PENDENT = literally HANGING / DANGLING from someone else. Koala-cling + post-it notes asking for guidance + urgent search for replacement when partner leaves = pathognomonic.
dependent_pd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥5 of 8): (1) Difficulty making everyday decisions without excessive advice/reassurance; (2) Needs others to assume responsibility for most major areas of life; (3) Difficulty expressing disagreement for fear of loss of support; (4) Difficulty initiating projects on own; (5) Goes to excessive lengths to obtain nurturance, even volunteering for unpleasant tasks; (6) Feels uncomfortable or helpless when alone, fears of being unable to care for self; (7) Urgently seeks another relationship when a close one ends; (8) Unrealistically preoccupied with fears of being left to take care of self. Higher prevalence in women in clinical samples; may persist into late life. Differential: distinguished from healthy interdependence by impairment + pervasive submissiveness.
dependent_pd.hebrew_explanation: DEPENDENT PD — מבוגר בן 35 נצמד כקואלה לגב חבר, חבר נושא אותו, לא יכול ללכת בעצמו. פוסט-איטים על חבר 'מה ללבוש?' 'איזה ארוחה?' 'איזו עבודה?'. אומר 'מה שאת תחליטי הכי טוב!' על כל החלטה. כשבן-זוג קודם עוזב — מיד מחפש מחליף בטלפון. נמנע מאי-הסכמה. קריטריונים (≥5 מ-8): קושי בהחלטות יומיומיות ללא ייעוץ; צריך שאחרים יקחו אחריות; קושי לחלוק על דעה; קושי ליזום פרויקטים; הולך רחוק כדי להשיג טיפוח (גם משימות לא נעימות); אי-נוחות/חוסר אונים לבד; מחפש דחוף קשר חדש כשנפסק קודם; פחדים לא מציאותיים מטיפול-עצמי. שכיח יותר בנשים בקליניקה. אבחנה-מבדלת: לא תלות בריאה — תלות פתולוגית עם ליקוי + צייתנות חוצה.

ocpd.category: Cluster C — Obsessive-Compulsive Personality Disorder (OCPD) — distinct from OCD
ocpd.symbol: OCPD's COLOR-CODED OFFICE — a person sits at a desk in a hyper-organized office, measuring the alignment of pencils with a ruler. Every binder on the shelf is labeled in identical handwriting and color-coded by quarter. A massive flowchart on the wall details the 'optimal morning routine' down to the second. The person can't enjoy lunch because they're still 'just finishing this spreadsheet' that has been perfect for hours. Family photos on the desk show them MISSING their children's recitals because they 'had to fix the database'. They refuse to delegate ('no one else does it right'). A piggy-bank labeled 'NEVER SPEND' is full. They cannot throw away an old broken stapler because 'I might need it'. They write down ethical principles to follow. A speech bubble: 'There's a RIGHT way to do this'.
ocpd.mnemonic_link: OCPD = OBSESSIVE-COMPULSIVE PERSONALITY (PERFECTIONISM trait), NOT OCD (which has true obsessions/compulsions that are EGO-DYSTONIC). OCPD is EGO-SYNTONIC — they LIKE being this way; they think everyone else is wrong. Color-coded everything + missing family events for work + refusing to throw away broken stapler = pathognomonic.
ocpd.function_depiction: DSM Criteria (≥4 of 8): (1) Preoccupation with details, rules, lists, order, organization, schedules to the extent that the major point of activity is lost; (2) Perfectionism that interferes with task completion; (3) Excessive devotion to work and productivity to the exclusion of leisure and friendships (not from economic necessity); (4) Overconscientious, scrupulous, inflexible about matters of morality, ethics, or values; (5) Unable to discard worn-out or worthless objects, even without sentimental value (vs hoarding disorder = clutter, distress); (6) Reluctant to delegate or work with others unless they submit to exactly the person's way; (7) Adopts miserly spending style toward self and others (money hoarded against future catastrophe); (8) Rigidity and stubbornness. KEY DIFFERENTIAL from OCD: OCPD lacks true obsessions and compulsions; the personality features are ego-syntonic (they don't experience distress about being this way — others do).
ocpd.hebrew_explanation: OCPD — דמות במשרד בצבעים מקודדים מודדת יישור עפרונות. כל קלסר מסומן בזהה. תרשים-זרימה אופטימלי לשגרת בוקר. לא נהנית מארוחת צהריים — 'רק עוד דקה לסיים את הקובץ'. מחמיצה אירועי משפחה כי 'חייבת לתקן את מסד הנתונים'. לא מאצילה ('רק אני יודעת לעשות נכון'). אוגרת כסף. לא זורקת מהדק שבור 'אולי אצטרך'. סלוגן: 'יש דרך נכונה'. הבדל קריטי מ-OCD: OCPD = ego-syntonic (הדמות חושבת שכולם טועים, היא בסדר); OCD = ego-dystonic (האדם סובל מהאובססיות/הקומפולסיות, רוצה להפסיק). קריטריונים (≥4 מ-8): עיסוק בפרטים/חוקים/רשימות; פרפקציוניזם; מסירות מוגזמת לעבודה; מצפוניות מוגזמת; חוסר השלכת חפצים; חוסר אצילה; חיסכון קמצני; נוקשות. אבחנה-מבדלת מ-Hoarding Disorder: ב-OCPD יש חוסר השלכה אבל לא הצטברות אקסטרמית עם distress.

DSM_paraphilic.symbol: A 'CAUTION' sign — atypical sexual interest causing distress or harm
DSM_paraphilic.function_depiction: Voyeuristic, Exhibitionistic, Frotteuristic, Sexual Masochism, Sexual Sadism, Pedophilic, Fetishistic, Transvestic. Forensic + ethical implications. CBT + sometimes anti-androgens.
DSM_paraphilic.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק paraphilic. סמל: שלט 'CAUTION' — עניין מיני אטיפי שגורם distress או נזק. Voyeuristic, Exhibitionistic, Frotteuristic, Masochism, Sadism, Pedophilic, Fetishistic, Transvestic. השלכות פורנזיות + אתיות. CBT + לפעמים anti-androgens.

DSM_medication_induced.category: Medication-Induced Movement Disorders & Other Adverse Effects
DSM_medication_induced.symbol: A pharmacy with bottles labeled 'NMS', 'Serotonin Syndrome', 'EPS', 'Akathisia', 'TD', 'Lithium toxicity', 'Discontinuation syndrome'
DSM_medication_induced.mnemonic_link: Drug-caused syndromes get their own chapter.
DSM_medication_induced.function_depiction: All the side-effect symbols above belong here. Recognize + treat + prevent.
DSM_medication_induced.hebrew_explanation: DSM פרק תרופתי. בית מרקחת עם בקבוקים: NMS, Serotonin Syndrome, EPS, Akathisia, TD, Lithium toxicity, Discontinuation syndrome. זהה + טפל + מנע.

developmental_ladder.category: Generic developmental milestones — 5 domains as a tiered building
developmental_ladder.symbol: A 5-storey BUILDER'S TOWER under construction with scaffolding. Each floor has a young apprentice working on a punning artifact that names its developmental domain. Floor 1 (ground level — MOTOR): apprentice assembles a tiny MOTORCYCLE in a garage (Motor → motorcycle pun). Floor 2 (LANGUAGE): apprentice hangs disembodied TONGUES on a rack feeding a TRANSLATOR machine (Language → tongues pun). Floor 3 (COGNITIVE): apprentice polishes massive brass COG-WHEELS that interlock (Cognitive → cog pun). Floor 4 (SOCIAL-EMOTIONAL): apprentice calibrates an 'EMO-METER' machine while two children hug nearby (Social-Emotional → emo-meter pun). Floor 5 (ADAPTIVE — top floor): apprentice plugs an electrical ADAPTER into different outlets (Adaptive → adapter pun). Above the top floor a banner reads 'DEVELOPMENT 5'. A young master-builder climbs up the scaffolding past each completed floor.
developmental_ladder.mnemonic_link: Five puns naming the five domains in order: MOTORCYCLE-TONGUES-COGS-EMOMETER-ADAPTER. Tower height = sequential mastery. Each floor must be 'built' before the next solidifies.
developmental_ladder.function_depiction: Each floor = a domain that must be developed. Missing floor = delay in that domain. Construction halted on a floor = developmental arrest. Demolition of a floor that was already built = regression. Uneven floors (one tall, one stunted) = uneven development across domains.
developmental_ladder.hebrew_explanation: מגדל-בנאי בן 5 קומות. כל קומה = תחום אבן-דרך עם פאן ויזואלי: אופנוע (MOTOR), לשונות+מתרגם (LANGUAGE), גלגלי-שיניים (COG-nitive), מד-רגש EMO-METER (Social-Emotional), שקע ADAPTER (ADAPT-ive). שלט עליון: 'DEVELOPMENT 5'. חסרון קומה = עיכוב בתחום. הריסת קומה = רגרסיה. קומות לא-שוות = התפתחות לא-אחידה.

erikson_8_stages.category: Erik Erikson — 8 psychosocial crises across lifespan
erikson_8_stages.symbol: ERIKSON-LAND — a colorful luna park with 8 themed attractions arranged in a winding path. A mustached conductor 'Erik' stands at the entrance gate. Each attraction is a SPLIT-MECHANISM ride showing both the WIN and LOSE pole of one psychosocial crisis, with the AGE embedded as a count of objects. (1) 'TRUST-FALL TOWER' — a single tall slide-tower with a giant '1' on its side. WIN: baby falls back into a pillow-pit while a parent catches them giggling. LOSE: parent is absent — pillow has a label 'MISS-trust' and the baby falls onto bare floor. (2) 'BUMPER-AUTO TRACK' with exactly THREE bumper-cars (3=age). WIN: toddler in a car painted 'ME!' driving proudly (AUTO-of-mine = AUTONOMY). LOSE: another toddler with a giant red SHAME-MASK on their face, surrounded by question-mark doubts. (3) 'SIX-SHOOTER STARTING-RACE' with SIX toy pistols and six racing kids (6=age). WIN: kid in a hero cape pulls the trigger first, confetti explodes with 'IGNITE!' = INITIATE. LOSE: kid mis-fires before the gun; the judge stamps 'GUILTY' on the kid's forehead with a giant G. (4) 'DOZEN FACTORY' with TWELVE widgets on a conveyor (12=age, dozen). WIN: kid operates the INDUSTRIAL conveyor producing twelve perfect gold widgets. LOSE: a second kid sits LITERALLY UNDER the conveyor belt (INFERIOR = below) catching broken widgets falling on their head, an 'F' grade card beside them. (5) 'MIRROR MAZE — 18 MIRRORS' with eighteen mirrors (18=age). WIN: teen finds the one true mirror with a glowing 'ID' stamp on it = IDENTITY. LOSE: another teen surrounded by five distorted role-mirrors each showing a different costume (rocker / scientist / athlete / artist / rebel) with bubbles asking 'WHICH ROLE?' = Role Confusion. (6) 'TUNNEL OF 2 HEARTS' with two giant hearts at entrance. WIN: a couple in a swan-boat holding hands beneath the two hearts ('IN-TEAM!' sign). LOSE: a lone figure in a tiny boat on a sad ice-isle ('ICE-O-LATE' = ISOLATE). (7) 'GENERATOR CAROUSEL' with sixty-five lights and a retirement-clock set to 65 (65=age). WIN: middle-aged person cranks a GEN-erator handle; carousel lights blaze, children laugh on the horses. LOSE: another figure stuck on a STAG-horse (male deer, unmoving) with dust everywhere and a banner 'STAG-NATION!' (pun on STAGNATION = stuck-STAG nation). (8) 'DE-PAIR PHOTO-BOOTH' with a sign '80+'. WIN: an elder steps out with a complete life-MOSAIC photo stamped with an INTEGRAL sign ∫ = INTEGRITY. LOSE: another elder receives a photo torn into two mismatched halves ('DE-PAIR-ed!'), behind them DESCENDING STAIRS lead into darkness (DE-SCEND = DE-SPAIR = DESPAIR).
erikson_8_stages.mnemonic_link: ERIKSON-LAND unifies all 8 crises in one luna park. Numbers are embedded as object-counts (1 slide, 3 bumper cars, 6 toy guns, 12 widgets, 18 mirrors, 2 hearts, 65 lights, 80+ sign). Each conflict name has a visual pun in the WIN or LOSE side: MISS-trust, AUTO-of-mine, IGNITE/INITIATE + GUILTY-STAMP, INDUSTRY-factory + INFERIOR(below), ID-stamp + WHICH-ROLE, IN-TEAM + ICE-O-LATE, GENERATOR + STAG-NATION, INTEGRAL ∫ + DE-PAIR/DE-SPAIR.
erikson_8_stages.function_depiction: Each attraction = a Erikson stage with a WIN (positive resolution) or LOSE (negative resolution) outcome. Pediatric stages 1-5: Trust vs Mistrust (0-1y), Autonomy vs Shame/Doubt (1-3y), Initiative vs Guilt (3-6y), Industry vs Inferiority (6-12y), Identity vs Role Confusion (12-18y). Adult stages 6-8 (Intimacy/Isolation, Generativity/Stagnation, Integrity/Despair) included for lifelong adjustment understanding.
erikson_8_stages.hebrew_explanation: ארץ-אריקסון — לונה פארק עם 8 אטרקציות, כל אחת מציגה את הקונפליקט עם WIN/LOSE ועם המספר/גיל מובנה. 1 (גיל 1): מגדל TRUST-FALL — אמון/MISS-trust. 2 (גיל 3): 3 מכוניות BUMPER-AUTO — אוטונומיה (ME!) / בושה (SHAME-MASK). 3 (גיל 6): 6 רובי SIX-SHOOTER — יוזמה (IGNITE!) / אשמה (GUILTY-STAMP). 4 (גיל 12): מפעל DOZEN עם 12 ווידג'טים — תעשייתיות / INFERIOR (יושב מתחת). 5 (גיל 18): מבוך 18 מראות — זהות (ID-stamp) / בלבול-תפקיד (5 תלבושות). 6: מנהרת 2 לבבות — אינטימיות (IN-TEAM) / בידוד (ICE-O-LATE). 7 (גיל 65): קרוסלת גנרטור — יצרנות (GEN-erator) / קיפאון (STAG-NATION). 8 (גיל 80+): תא-תמונה — שלמות (INTEGRAL ∫) / ייאוש (DE-PAIR + מדרגות יורדות).

piaget_4_stages.category: Jean Piaget — 4 stages of cognitive development
piaget_4_stages.symbol: PIAGET'S PRE-OP HOSPITAL — a children's hospital with 4 wards each labeled with a stage; all four are 'OP' (operation) wards, unifying the theory. 'Dr. Pia-zhay' (white coat, big round glasses, French beret) tours visitors through. WARD 1 — 'SENSORY-MOTOR ER' (Sensorimotor 0-2y): a newborn in a crib reaches for their toes and kicks a peekaboo mobile; Dr. Pia-zhay demonstrates 'object permanence' by hiding a stuffed bear under a blanket and revealing it. Sign reads 'Senses + Motor only — no symbols yet'. WARD 2 — 'PRE-OP HOLDING ROOM' (Preoperational 2-7y): toddlers in colorful operating gowns play with imaginary friends and dragons painted on the walls; one toddler insists 'I'm taller than you!' though clearly shorter (egocentric, no conservation). Sign: 'PRE-OP = before logical operation'. WARD 3 — 'CONCRETE-OP SURGERY' (Concrete-Operational 7-11y): school-age children in hardhats pour water between a tall-thin glass and a short-wide glass, correctly declaring 'same volume' (conservation experiment); they sort blocks by size and color. Sign: 'CONCRETE-OP = operation on concrete objects'. WARD 4 — 'FORMAL-OP CONFERENCE' (Formal-Operational 11+y): teenagers in suits at a conference table solve abstract algebra on a chalkboard, debating hypothetical 'what-if' scenarios. Sign: 'FORMAL-OP = abstract operation'. Glowing rooftop sign: 'PIAGET HOSPITAL'.
piaget_4_stages.mnemonic_link: All 4 stages are 'OP' (operation) wards in the same hospital, in chronological order: SENSORY-MOTOR ER → PRE-OP → CONCRETE-OP → FORMAL-OP. Dr. 'Pia-zhay' rhymes the theorist's name into the tour.
piaget_4_stages.function_depiction: Sensorimotor (0-2y) — object permanence emerges. Preoperational (2-7y) — symbolic play, egocentrism, no conservation, magical thinking. Concrete Operational (7-11y) — conservation, reversibility, hierarchical classification (concrete objects only). Formal Operational (11+y) — abstract reasoning, hypothetico-deductive thinking, metacognition.
piaget_4_stages.hebrew_explanation: בית-החולים של פיאז'ה — 4 מחלקות 'OP' (operation): SENSORY-MOTOR ER (0-2, object permanence) → PRE-OP (2-7, אגוצנטריות, אין שימור, חשיבה מאגית) → CONCRETE-OP (7-11, שימור, הפיכות) → FORMAL-OP (11+, חשיבה מופשטת, hypothetico-deductive). דר' פיא-ז'אי (לבוש לבן + בארט צרפתי) מסייר במחלקות ומדגים.

mahler_phases.category: Margaret Mahler — separation-individuation theory (3 main phases + 4 sub-stages)
mahler_phases.symbol: GUSTAV MAHLER SYMPHONY HALL — a grand concert hall (a pun on the composer Gustav Mahler) where Maestro 'Margaret Mahler' conducts a 3-movement symphony of early development. She wears a tuxedo over a pediatrician's white coat. MOVEMENT 1 — 'AUTISTIC overture' (0-2 months): a single muffled musician sits inside a soundproof glass booth playing softly to themselves, unaware of the audience (normal autistic phase — infant unaware of others). MOVEMENT 2 — 'SYMBIOTIC duet' (2-6 months): two musicians (mother + baby) play with their bow-arms physically tied together by a ribbon, perfectly synchronized; sheet music above reads 'M+I = ONE' (dual-unity / fusion). MOVEMENT 3 — 'SEPARATION-INDIVIDUATION suite' (4-36 months) is performed by 4 instrumentalists who progressively separate from the conductor: (a) DIFFERENTIATION / Hatching (4-10mo) — a string player peeks out curiously from BEHIND A CURTAIN, looking around for the first time. Subtitle: 'hatching'. (b) PRACTICING (10-15mo) — a brass-section player marches confidently toward the front of the stage, trumpet raised high, exuberant smile. Subtitle: 'love affair with the world'. (c) RAPPROCHEMENT (15-24mo) — a woodwind player RUNS BACK AND FORTH between the conductor's podium and the stage edge, alternately playing solo then rushing back for reassurance. Subtitle: 'ambivalent shadowing'. (d) OBJECT CONSTANCY (24-36mo) — a percussionist keeps a steady beat calmly even when the conductor walks OFFSTAGE; the musician holds the conductor's mental image and plays on independently. Subtitle: 'internalized mother'. Banner above the stage: 'MAHLER SYMPHONY — From One to Self'.
mahler_phases.mnemonic_link: Composer Gustav Mahler's SYMPHONY pun = Margaret Mahler's DEVELOPMENTAL THEORY. 3 movements = 3 main phases (Autistic / Symbiotic / Separation-Individuation). 4 instrumentalists separating in movement 3 = 4 sub-stages: Differentiation (peek from curtain / hatching) → Practicing (march forward) → Rapprochement (run back-and-forth) → Object Constancy (play while conductor offstage).
mahler_phases.function_depiction: Normal Autistic (0-2mo) — infant unaware of others. Symbiotic (2-6mo) — fused dual-unity with caregiver. Separation-Individuation (4-36mo): Differentiation/hatching (4-10mo) — physical separation begins. Practicing (10-15mo) — exuberant exploration ('love affair with the world'). Rapprochement (15-24mo) — increased awareness of separateness; ambivalence about independence (the rapprochement crisis). Object Constancy (24-36mo) — internalized mother allows tolerance of separation. Failure of object constancy → Borderline PD organization (per Kernberg's developmental model).
mahler_phases.hebrew_explanation: אולם-קונצרטים של גוסטב Mahler (פאן על מרגרט Mahler). 3 פרקים. פרק 1 — שלב אוטיסטי (0-2 חוד): סולן בתא-זכוכית. פרק 2 — סימביוזה (2-6 חוד): 2 נגנים מאוחים בסרט, שלט 'M+I = ONE'. פרק 3 — Separation-Individuation (4-36 חוד) עם 4 תת-שלבים: (א) Differentiation/hatching (4-10): נגן מציץ מאחורי וילון. (ב) Practicing (10-15): נגן צועד גאה לקדמת הבמה. (ג) Rapprochement (15-24): נגן רץ קדימה-אחורה למנצח. (ד) Object Constancy (24-36): נגן ממשיך לנגן גם כשהמנצח עזב. כישלון object constancy → אישיות גבולית (Kernberg).

attachment_4_styles.category: John Bowlby + Mary Ainsworth — 4 attachment styles (Strange Situation paradigm)
attachment_4_styles.symbol: AINSWORTH'S STRANGE SITUATION ROOM — a research observation playroom. On one wall is a large ONE-WAY MIRROR behind which Mary Ainsworth herself stands with a clipboard and a stopwatch, taking notes. The room is divided into four corners, each enacting one attachment style during the REUNION moment (the diagnostic point — after mother has briefly left and returned). CORNER 1 — SECURE attachment (~60%): toddler runs joyfully toward the returning mother, gets a quick hug, calms within seconds, then returns to exploring toys. Sign: 'SECURE = uses mother as base'. CORNER 2 — ANXIOUS-AMBIVALENT (~10%): toddler simultaneously CLINGS to mother's leg AND pushes her away with the other hand, sobbing inconsolably for many minutes — 'I want you, but I'm angry'. Sign: 'AMBIVALENT'. CORNER 3 — AVOIDANT (~20%): toddler IGNORES the returning mother, turns away pointedly, continues playing as if she were invisible. Sign: 'AVOIDANT'. CORNER 4 — DISORGANIZED (~10%, trauma-linked): toddler shows CONTRADICTORY behavior — approaches mother with head turned away, freezes mid-step, then collapses to the floor. Sign: 'DISORGANIZED'. Above each corner: a small video monitor replaying the separation moment for context. Banner: 'STRANGE SITUATION — Reunion reveals all'. In a separate panel: John Bowlby (the theorist) sketches the theory in a notebook.
attachment_4_styles.mnemonic_link: STRANGE SITUATION = the actual research paradigm name. 4 corners in one room = 4 styles. The REUNION moment is the diagnostic. Ainsworth observes behind the mirror; Bowlby (separate panel) is the theorist.
attachment_4_styles.function_depiction: Secure (~60%) = best outcome — caregiver is reliable safe base for exploration. Anxious-Ambivalent (~10%) — inconsistent caregiver, child uncertain. Avoidant (~20%) — rejecting caregiver, child suppresses attachment needs. Disorganized (~10%) — frightening or frightened caregiver (often trauma/abuse) — strongest predictor of later BPD, dissociation, and complex trauma symptoms. Bowlby = theoretical framework; Ainsworth = empirical paradigm.
attachment_4_styles.hebrew_explanation: חדר 'המצב הזר' של Ainsworth — חדר מחקר עם מראה חד-כיוונית; Mary Ainsworth מתעדת בלוח. 4 פינות לסצנת איחוד. Secure (~60%): רץ לאמא, מתחבק, נרגע, חוזר לשחק. Anxious-Ambivalent (~10%): דבק + מתנגד, בוכה בלי הפסקה. Avoidant (~20%): מתעלם, פונה הצד. Disorganized (~10%, קשור לטראומה): מתנהג סותר, קופא, מתמוטט — predictor חזק של BPD ו-dissociation. בפאנל-צד: John Bowlby רושם את התיאוריה.

freud_5_psychosexual.category: Sigmund Freud — 5 psychosexual stages of development
freud_5_psychosexual.symbol: FREUD'S DREAM COUCH — Sigmund Freud (white beard, round wire-rim glasses, cigar in mouth) reclines on his iconic Persian-rug-covered psychoanalytic couch. Above his head float FIVE thought-bubbles in chronological sequence, each containing a vignette of one psychosexual stage. BUBBLE 1 — ORAL (0-18mo): a happy baby sucking on a pacifier with extra pacifiers floating nearby; a small inset shows an adult chain-smoker with a pen between lips (oral fixation). BUBBLE 2 — ANAL (18mo-3y): a toddler on a potty surrounded by neatly folded toilet-paper rolls; insets show an obsessively tidy adult (anal-retentive, OCPD-like) and a sloppy disorganized adult (anal-expulsive). BUBBLE 3 — PHALLIC (3-6y): a small child notices gender differences between parents; an Oedipal vignette — a little boy hands his mother flowers while dad watches uneasily, and an Electra vignette — a little girl sits in dad's lap while mom looks on. BUBBLE 4 — LATENCY (6-12y): same-sex children play baseball/soccer together, no romantic interest, focus on skills and same-sex friendships. BUBBLE 5 — GENITAL (12+y): two adolescents at a candlelit cafe table holding hands, mature romantic interest. On Freud's side table: a CIGAR BOX with the famous quote 'Sometimes a cigar is just a cigar?'. A small sign by the couch: 'TELL ME ABOUT YOUR MOTHER'.
freud_5_psychosexual.mnemonic_link: Freud's iconic couch holds him while he dreams the 5 stages above his head. Each bubble shows the body-zone focus of that stage. Memory aid: 'Old Age Pensioners Love Grapes' (OAPLG) = Oral / Anal / Phallic / Latency / Genital.
freud_5_psychosexual.function_depiction: Oral (0-18mo) — pleasure via mouth (sucking, biting). Fixation: smoking, overeating, oral aggression. Anal (18mo-3y) — control via bowel movements (potty training). Fixation: anal-retentive (rigid, perfectionist, OCPD-like) or anal-expulsive (messy, disorganized). Phallic (3-6y) — gender awareness; Oedipus complex (boy → mother) and Electra complex (girl → father). Fixation: identity / relationship issues. Latency (6-12y) — sexual drives latent; same-sex friendships, skill mastery. Genital (12+y) — mature sexuality, capacity for adult love. Freud's stages are historically central but largely superseded; lasting contributions: the unconscious, defense mechanisms, transference, dream interpretation.
freud_5_psychosexual.hebrew_explanation: ספת-החלום של פרויד — סיגמונד פרויד שכוב על ספתו המפורסמת, מעל ראשו 5 בועות-מחשבה: Oral (0-18m, פטמה + עישון כ-fixation), Anal (18m-3y, סיר ונייר טואלט; fixation = OCPD מסודר או מבולגן), Phallic (3-6y, הבדלי-מגדר, Oedipus/Electra), Latency (6-12y, חברויות חד-מיניות, מיומנויות), Genital (12+y, אהבה בוגרת). מנמוניק לסדר: 'Old Age Pensioners Love Grapes' = OAPLG. תרומות-מפתח: לא-מודע, מנגנוני הגנה, transference, פירוש חלומות.

vygotsky_zpd.category: Lev Vygotsky — Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD) and scaffolding
vygotsky_zpd.symbol: VYGOTSKY'S ZPD BRIDGE — a wide canyon between two cliffs. LEFT CLIFF labeled 'CAN DO ALONE' has a child confidently riding a tricycle on solid ground, surrounded by mastered objects. RIGHT CLIFF labeled 'CANNOT YET DO' is across the chasm, with desired goals visible (algebra textbook, advanced puzzle, violin). Between the cliffs stretches a ROPE-BRIDGE labeled in big letters 'ZPD = Zone of Proximal Development'. On the bridge a child crosses carefully, while a SCAFFOLDING-PERSON walks beside them — literally a kind teacher / older peer wearing a construction-scaffolding outfit (metal frame around their body). The scaffolding-person holds the bridge ropes for safety and offers verbal hints in speech-bubbles ('try this hand-hold!', 'almost there!'). As the child reaches the right cliff, the scaffolding falls away in pieces (= scaffolding fades as the skill is internalized). At the canyon edge stands Vygotsky himself (round glasses, Russian-style coat, holding a chalkboard) pointing to the bridge. A sub-sign reads: 'Learning is social and language-mediated'.
vygotsky_zpd.mnemonic_link: ZPD BRIDGE = literal bridge between 'can-do' and 'cannot-yet'. SCAFFOLDING-PERSON wearing construction-scaffolding outfit = the literal metaphor for teacher support. Speech-bubbles from the helper = social mediation of learning. Vygotsky at the cliff = the theorist.
vygotsky_zpd.function_depiction: ZPD = the gap between what a child can do INDEPENDENTLY and what they can do with GUIDED ASSISTANCE from a more competent peer or adult. Scaffolding = temporary support that fades as competence grows. Learning is fundamentally SOCIAL and language-mediated — internal speech develops out of dialogue with others. Contrasts with Piaget's individual-discovery model.
vygotsky_zpd.hebrew_explanation: גשר ה-ZPD של ויגוצקי — קניון בין 2 צוקים. שמאל: 'CAN DO ALONE' (ילד על תלת-אופן). ימין: 'CANNOT YET DO' (ספר אלגברה, פאזל מתקדם, כינור). באמצע: גשר-חבלים 'ZPD = אזור התפתחות פרוקסימלי'. מורה-פיגום (לבוש כפיגום-בניין מתכתי) מלווה את הילד עם רמזים-קוליים בבועות. הפיגום נופל כשהילד מגיע ליעד = הפנמה. ויגוצקי על הצוק עם לוח-גיר. למידה היא חברתית ומתווכת-שפה. בניגוד לפיאז'ה (גילוי עצמי).

thomas_chess_temperament.symbol: Three babies in cribs: 'Easy' baby smiling and regular; 'Difficult' baby crying with irregular patterns; 'Slow-to-warm-up' baby curious-cautious
thomas_chess_temperament.mnemonic_link: Three cribs = three temperaments. 9 dimensions cluster into these.
thomas_chess_temperament.function_depiction: Easy ~40% — regular, positive. Difficult ~10% — irregular, intense. Slow-to-warm ~15% — withdraws then adapts. Goodness-of-fit matters more than the type.
thomas_chess_temperament.hebrew_explanation: 3 סוגי טמפרמנט (Thomas & Chess). Easy ~40% (סדיר, חיובי). Difficult ~10% (לא סדיר, אינטנסיבי). Slow-to-warm-up ~15% (נסוג ואז מתאקלם). Goodness-of-fit הורה-ילד > הסוג עצמו.

brazelton_still_face.symbol: Mother and 4-month-old baby face-to-face. Three frames: (1) playful engagement, (2) mother freezes neutral 'still face', (3) baby protests, looks away, distress
brazelton_still_face.mnemonic_link: The still face = withdrawal of contingent response, infant distress.
brazelton_still_face.function_depiction: Demonstrates: infants require contingent affective response. Foundation for attunement, repair, emotional regulation roots.
brazelton_still_face.hebrew_explanation: Still-Face paradigm (Tronick) — אם-תינוק 4 חודשים מול-מול. 3 פריימים: משחק → אם 'קופאת' → התינוק מתעצב. מדגים: תינוקות זקוקים לתגובה רגשית מותאמת. בסיס ל-attunement + repair.

winnicott_holding.category: Winnicott — holding + transitional object + good-enough mother
winnicott_holding.symbol: Mother holding infant in her arms with a TEDDY BEAR nearby. A glowing AURA around them = 'holding environment'. Label: 'good-enough mother'.
winnicott_holding.mnemonic_link: Teddy = transitional object. Aura = holding. Imperfect mother = good-enough.
winnicott_holding.function_depiction: Transitional object bridges symbiosis-to-separateness. Good-enough = optimally frustrating, necessary for developing self.
winnicott_holding.hebrew_explanation: Winnicott — אם מחזיקה תינוק, דובון לידם, הילה זוהרת = 'holding environment'. הדובון = אובייקט מעבר. 'good-enough mother' = לא מושלם, מתסכל-באופן-אופטימלי.

klein_positions.symbol: Two paintings side-by-side. Left: a baby with a SPLIT good-vs-bad breast (paranoid-schizoid, ~0-6 months). Right: an older baby reconciling whole-object ambivalence (depressive position, 6+ months).
klein_positions.function_depiction: Failure to integrate = persistence of splitting, BPD-like dynamics.
klein_positions.hebrew_explanation: Klein — שתי ציורים. שמאל: שד split (good/bad) = paranoid-schizoid (~0-6 חודשים). ימין: אובייקט שלם עם ambivalence = depressive (6+ חודשים). כישלון אינטגרציה = splitting BPD.

anna_freud_defenses.symbol: A pyramid with 3 levels: PRIMITIVE (denial, projection, splitting), NEUROTIC (repression, displacement, intellectualization), MATURE (sublimation, humor, altruism)
anna_freud_defenses.function_depiction: BPD = primitive; OCPD = neurotic-intellectualization; healthy = mature.
anna_freud_defenses.hebrew_explanation: Anna Freud — פירמידת מנגנוני הגנה. PRIMITIVE (denial, projection, splitting — BPD), NEUROTIC (repression, displacement, intellectualization — OCPD), MATURE (sublimation, humor, altruism).

kohut_self_psychology.symbol: Three child-parent dyads: (1) Mirror — parent reflects grandiosity; (2) Idealizing — child looks up to powerful parent; (3) Twinship — child and like-other engage as same-kind
kohut_self_psychology.function_depiction: Empathic failure to narcissistic vulnerability. Therapy = reparative selfobject experience.
kohut_self_psychology.hebrew_explanation: Kohut — 3 דיאדות. Mirroring, Idealizing, Twinship. כישלון אמפתיה → פגיעות נרציסטית. טיפול = חוויה selfobject מתקנת.

fonagy_mentalization.symbol: Two thought bubbles linked between a parent and child — parent imagines child's mental state, child learns to imagine others' minds
fonagy_mentalization.mnemonic_link: Mind in mind. Linked bubbles = reflective bridge.
fonagy_mentalization.function_depiction: Pre-mentalistic modes: psychic-equivalence, pretend-mode. BPD = fragmented. MBT builds the capacity.
fonagy_mentalization.hebrew_explanation: Fonagy mentalization — בועות מחשבה מקושרות בין הורה לילד. Pre-mentalistic: psychic-equivalence, pretend-mode. BPD = mentalization מקוטעת. MBT = בניית היכולת.

developmental_red_flags.category: Cross-cutting developmental red flags — 5 missed milestones
developmental_red_flags.symbol: A wall with 5 distinct framed scenes (plus a 6th regression frame). Each frame in a different setting and color, with the AGE embedded in the visual identity itself. Frame 1 (black/white dojo) — NINJA-baby in a NIN-cradle shaped like a '9', finger on silenced lips, mouth covered by ninja mask (NIN = 9 in Japanese; no babbling). Frame 2 (red town square at noon) — giant CLOCK-TOWER showing 12:00, parent points at sky-bird but baby stares at own toes (no joint attention). Frame 3 (golden Israeli souvenir shop) — toddler wearing a חי (Chai = 18 in Hebrew gematria) necklace pendant, holding above their head a comic SPEECH-BUBBLE that is empty or filled only with picture-symbols (heart, moon, ball — NO real words). Frame 4 (blue neon 24/7 convenience store) — toddler holding TWO unconnected word-cards 'JUICE' and 'PLEASE' with a visible gap between them (no 2-word phrases). Frame 5 (green spring park) — child sitting on a TRICYCLE (3 wheels = 3 years), beside them an unimagined cardboard box being used only as a stool (no symbolic play). Frame 6 (black-and-white calendar room) — wall-calendar with REVERSED time-arrow, child stepping backward from 'WORDS' to 'BABBLE' (regression at any age).
developmental_red_flags.mnemonic_link: 9=NIN-ja silent in 9-shaped cradle. 12=clock noon with missed joint-pointing. 18=חי gematria necklace + empty speech bubble. 24=24/7 store with un-combinable words. 36=tricycle 3-wheels + un-imagined box. Regression=reversed time-arrow.
developmental_red_flags.function_depiction: Each frame = a milestone NOT met by that age = needs immediate referral, never wait-and-see. Loss of any acquired skill at any age (regression) = always concerning (Rett, ASD, neurodegenerative). No joint attention at 12mo = early ASD marker.
developmental_red_flags.hebrew_explanation: 5 פריימים מודאגים בקיר + פריים רגרסיה. 9 חוד: תינוק נינ-ג'ה בעריסה בצורת '9', שותק (no babbling). 12 חוד: ילד מול שעון-עיר ב-12:00, לא עוקב אחר הצבעת הורה (no joint attention). 18 חוד: טודלר עם תליון 'חי' (18 בגימטריה) ובועת-דיבור ריקה (אין מילים). 24 חוד: חנות 24/7 — 2 כרטיסי-מילים לא מתחברים (אין צירופי-2-מילים). 36 חוד: תלת-אופן (3 גלגלים = 3 שנים) וקופסה שלא הופכת לחללית (אין משחק סמלי). רגרסיה: חץ-זמן הפוך, ילד פוסע לאחור.

psychosis_state.category: Clinical states — a person exhibiting it
psychosis_state.symbol: ANTENNAE on the head — two wire aerials with little knobs, sprouting from whatever headgear the scene already puts on that person (a hard hat on a site, a chef's toque in a kitchen, a cap in a yard). The antennae are the symbol; the hat is the scene's.
psychosis_state.mnemonic_link: Receiving transmissions nobody else receives — hallucinations and delusions, on the person who has them. Owner-approved from the 033 criteria plate, 2026-09-23: 'הבחור עם קסדת הבטיחות ... אחלה סמל חוזר פוטנציאלי למחשבות שווא או הזיות'.
psychosis_state.function_depiction: Worn by the figure who is psychotic, never by the scene at large. Bent or sparking antennae = more disorganized. Distinguish from DSM_psychotic, which marks the TOPIC (a cracked mirror in the room); this marks a PERSON.
psychosis_state.scene: any — the headgear follows the venue
psychosis_state.hebrew_explanation: אנטנות על הראש — שתי אנטנות עם כפתור בקצה, יוצאות מכל כיסוי ראש שהסצינה כבר נותנת לדמות (קסדת בטיחות באתר, כובע שף במטבח). האנטנות הן הסמל, הכובע שייך לסצינה. מסמן אדם עם הזיות או מחשבות שווא, להבדיל מ-DSM_psychotic שמסמן את הנושא.

Lithium.symbol: Giant Li-ion battery labeled 'Li' with charge indicator
Lithium.mnemonic_link: Li = chemical symbol on the battery.
Lithium.function_depiction: Narrow voltage band on the indicator = narrow therapeutic window (0.6–1.2 mEq/L). Overcharged battery EXPLODES = toxicity at >1.5 (tremor → ataxia → seizures → death). Rechargeable = mood stabilization between mania and depression.
Lithium.hebrew_explanation: ליתיום — סוללת Li-ion ענקית עם מד-טעינה. רוחב חלון מתח צר = חלון טיפולי 0.6-1.2 mEq/L. סוללה במתח-יתר מתפוצצת = רעלת >1.5 (רעד → אטקסיה → פרכוסים → קומה). ניטור TSH + Cr שנתיים.

Valproate.symbol: Bald PRO athlete in a valley, holding a giant cake (weight gain) and stroking his bald head
Valproate.mnemonic_link: VAL-PRO = Valley + Pro. Bald + cake = hair loss + weight gain.
Valproate.function_depiction: Broad mood stabilizer + anticonvulsant. Hepatotoxic warning = liver dangling. Teratogen = pregnant woman shooed away.
Valproate.hebrew_explanation: Valproate — אתלט מקצוען קירח בעמק עם עוגה גדולה. נושר שיער + עליה במשקל. רחב-spectrum (מצב רוח + נוגד פרכוסים). Hepatotoxic warning + טרטוגן (טרידה - black box פדיאטרי <2).

Lamotrigine.symbol: Lamb standing on a hair-trigger, with red rash on its wool
Lamotrigine.mnemonic_link: Lamb-O-Trij → 'Lamb-on-Trigger'. Red rash = SJS / TEN warning.
Lamotrigine.function_depiction: Slow titration = lamb slowly stepping onto trigger. Carbamazepine ↓ levels (induces metabolism). Valproate ↑ levels (inhibits) → must halve dose.
Lamotrigine.hebrew_explanation: Lamotrigine — כבש על trigger עם פריחה אדומה על הצמר. טיטרציה איטית! Carbamazepine ↓ רמות (induces); Valproate ↑ רמות (חצי המינון). מצב רוח. סיכון SJS.

Carbamazepine.symbol: A bread maze that redraws itself overnight
Carbamazepine.function_depiction: CYP-induces own metabolism (auto-induction). HLA-B*1502 in Asians = SJS risk. SIADH (low sodium) = the maze fills with water.
Carbamazepine.hebrew_explanation: Carbamazepine — מבוך לחם שמשרטט את עצמו מחדש מדי לילה. Carb + Maze. אוטו-אינדוקציה (CYP). HLA-B*1502 אסיינים = SJS. SIADH (היפונתרמיה).

Diazepam.symbol: Backpacker in a green valley by a slow stream (DIA)
Diazepam.mnemonic_link: Diaz → Day-az → Day in a calm valley.
Diazepam.function_depiction: Long t½ + active metabolites = pitches a tent (stays awhile). Used in alcohol withdrawal (taper agent).
Diazepam.hebrew_explanation: Diazepam — מטייל בעמק ירוק רגוע ליד נחל איטי. Dia = day-az = יום בעמק רגוע. t½ ארוך + מטבוליטים פעילים. ב-EtOH withdrawal taper.

Alprazolam.symbol: Short, fluffy alpaca with a 'high-potency' boxing glove
Alprazolam.mnemonic_link: ALP-acalpaca. Short fluffy = short t½, high potency.
Alprazolam.function_depiction: Panic attacks = alpaca punches the attack. Inter-dose rebound = alpaca tantrum mid-day. Avoid in adolescents = no kids around alpaca.
Alprazolam.hebrew_explanation: Alprazolam — אלפקה קטנה רכה עם כפפת אגרוף 'high-potency'. t½ קצר, potency גבוהה. פאניקה. רבאונד inter-dose. הימנע בנער/ה.

Lorazepam.symbol: Grandma by the fireplace telling ancient LORE
Lorazepam.function_depiction: Hepatic conjugation only (no oxidation) = grandma doesn't need her liver oven. Catatonia challenge = grandma jolts patient awake with a story. IV/IM/PO available.
Lorazepam.hebrew_explanation: Lorazepam — סבתא ליד האח מספרת LORE. מטבוליזם conjugation בלבד = בטוח בכבד + קשישים. Catatonia challenge. IV/IM/PO.

Clonazepam.symbol: Two identical CLONES walking together with long canes
Clonazepam.function_depiction: Long t½ = canes = stable, far walking. Less rebound than Alprazolam.
Clonazepam.hebrew_explanation: Clonazepam — שני clones זהים הולכים עם מקלות ארוכים. t½ ארוך = פחות רבאונד מ-Alprazolam.

Midazolam.symbol: King MIDAS with a stopwatch — anything he touches turns rapid
Midazolam.function_depiction: Rapid IM/IV/IN onset. Intranasal in pediatrics for seizures. Surgical sedation + amnesia (hits α5 vault on Floor 5).
Midazolam.hebrew_explanation: Midazolam — מלך MIDAS עם שעון עצר. כל מה שנוגע הופך מהיר. IM/IV/IN פעולה מהירה. פדיאטרי intranasal לפרכוסים.

Phenobarbital.symbol: Barbed-wire fence (BARB) encircling the Aa Hotel
Phenobarbital.function_depiction: Keeps the hotel doors open LONGER (↑duration). At high doses, the wire opens the hotel WITHOUT GABA → lethal.
Phenobarbital.hebrew_explanation: Phenobarbital — גדר תיל ברביר סביב מלון Aa. שומר על דלתות פתוחות זמן רב יותר. מינון גבוה פותח את המלון בלי GABA → קטלני.

Flumazenil.symbol: Security guard with the FLU — sneezing, throwing BZD partygoers out
Flumazenil.function_depiction: Competitive BZD antagonist. Can precipitate seizures in chronic BZD users.
Flumazenil.hebrew_explanation: Flumazenil — מאבטח עם FLU (מצונן), זורק BZD החוצה. אנטגוניסט תחרותי. עלול לעורר פרכוסים ב-BZD כרוני.

Fluoxetine.symbol: Glowing fluorescent OX that walks for weeks without resting
Fluoxetine.mnemonic_link: FLUO-OX → fluorescent ox. Glow = long t½ (the ox is 'lit up' for weeks).
Fluoxetine.function_depiction: Long t½ = ox needs slow taper or no taper. Best-tolerated in pediatric depression.
Fluoxetine.hebrew_explanation: Fluoxetine — שור פלורסנטי שזוהר במשך שבועות. FLUO+OX. t½ ארוך = self-taper. הכי נסבל בילדים.

Sertraline.symbol: Knight (SIR) riding on rails — straight, steady, dependable
Sertraline.function_depiction: Broad-spectrum SSRI. Decent first-line for PTSD.
Sertraline.hebrew_explanation: Sertraline — אביר על מסילה (SIR-on-RAIL). רחב, יציב. SSRI ראשון ל-PTSD.

Paroxetine.symbol: Ox jumping out of plane with a PARAchute
Paroxetine.function_depiction: Short t½ + strong anticholinergic = parachute may fail → severe discontinuation syndrome. Most sedating SSRI. Teratogen warning (cardiac defects).
Paroxetine.hebrew_explanation: Paroxetine — שור בצניחת מצנח (PARA-chute). t½ קצר + אנטיכולינרגי חזק = discontinuation syndrome חמור. הכי מרדים. טרטוגן.

Bupropion.symbol: Bumper-car arena — cars colliding with high energy
Bupropion.function_depiction: NDRI = energizing (no sedation, no sexual dysfunction). Smoking cessation. ↓Seizure threshold = sparks flying when bumpers crash too hard. Avoid in eating disorders.
Bupropion.hebrew_explanation: Bupropion — בומפר-קר באולם — מכוניות מתנגשות באנרגיה. NDRI מעורר. בלי dysfunction מיני, בלי סדציה. ↓סף פרכוסים. הימנע באכילה.

Mirtazapine.symbol: Person sitting in front of a MIRROR holding a slice of cake under a PINE tree
Mirtazapine.mnemonic_link: Mir + tas + pine → Mirror + cake + pine. Mirror = self-reflection at night (sedation). Cake = appetite/weight gain (5-HT2C + H1 block).
Mirtazapine.function_depiction: Strong H1 sedation, 5-HT2C → weight gain, 5-HT3 → antiemetic. Used in elderly with poor appetite + insomnia + nausea.
Mirtazapine.hebrew_explanation: Mirtazapine — אדם עם MIRror, עוגה ועץ אורן. ראי = self-reflection (סדציה). עוגה = תיאבון (5-HT2C + H1). 5-HT3 antiemetic. קשישים עם תיאבון נמוך + נדודי שינה.

Vortioxetine.symbol: Wise tortoise wearing glasses, slow but multi-tasking
Vortioxetine.function_depiction: Multimodal: SERT block + 5-HT1A agonist + 5-HT3/7 antagonist + 5-HT6 antagonist (procognitive). Tortoise = slow + smart.
Vortioxetine.hebrew_explanation: Vortioxetine — צב חכם עם משקפיים. רב-מודאלי: SERT + 5-HT1A agonist + 5-HT3/7 antagonist + 5-HT6 antagonist (procognitive). איטי + חכם.

Methylphenidate.symbol: A love-struck teenager glued to a PHONE on a romantic DATE: hearts and hearts-eyes float around them, cheeks blushing, utterly absorbed in the phone-call/text — a self-evident 'PHONE-DATE' (no text needed; the hearts + phone read instantly)
Methylphenidate.mnemonic_link: PHEN→PHONE, -i-DATE→DATE: a love-struck 'phone date'. The hearts + dreamy total absorption make the pun readable WITHOUT any label. (Methylphenidate = the classic first-line ADHD stimulant.)
Methylphenidate.function_depiction: DAT/NET inhibitor (blocks reuptake) → boosts focus/attention. First-line ADHD stimulant. Side effects: appetite suppression, insomnia, growth delay, ↑HR/BP; overdose → tics/EPS.
Methylphenidate.hebrew_explanation: Methylphenidate — נער/ה מאוהב/ת דבוק/ה לטלפון בדייט רומנטי: לבבות וברק-עיניים מסביב, לחיים סמוקות, שקוע/ה לגמרי בשיחה — 'PHONE-DATE' ברור מעצמו (PHEN=phone, -i-date=דייט), בלי צורך בטקסט. סטימולנט קו-ראשון ב-ADHD; חוסם DAT/NET.

Amphetamine.symbol: Guitar AMPlifier turned to 11 on stage
Amphetamine.function_depiction: DAT/NET inhibitor + RELEASER (extra mechanism). Stronger than Methylphenidate. Higher dependence.
Amphetamine.hebrew_explanation: Amphetamine — מגבר גיטרה מוגבר ל-11 על הבמה. AMP = amplifier. חוסם DAT/NET + RELEASER. חזק יותר מ-Methylphenidate. תלות גבוהה.
